title: Senior Design Development Engineer
description:
**About us:**

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role overview & Key responsibilities:**

The Senior Design and Development Engineer will play a key role in driving PadCare’s hardware innovation by taking ownership of product design, prototyping, testing, and manufacturing. The role requires strong CAD skills, hands-on fabrication knowledge, and a deep understanding of engineering principles to deliver high-quality sustainable products that align with PadCare’s mission.

* Create accurate 3D CAD models, detailed part and assembly drawings, and Bill of Materials (BOM) to support manufacturing and assembly.
* Lead the end-to-end product development cycle – from ideation and prototyping to manufacturing and field implementation.
* Take responsibility for team handling and effective execution of projects.
* Analyze and optimize existing designs for improved performance, cost-efficiency, and sustainability.
* Develop functional prototypes, conduct product testing, and incorporate user feedback into iterative improvements.
* Provide on-ground support during product development, trials, and implementation as required.
* Plan and manage design projects including timeline, budget, and workflow tracking.
* Collaborate with engineers, designers, and cross-functional teams to brainstorm and implement innovative product solutions.

**What we're looking for:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical / Production Engineering or Master’s in Mechanical Engineering.
* 4–6 years of experience in mechanical design and product development.
* Experience in team handling and project execution.
* Experience in managing multiple projects and coordinating with vendors or manufacturing teams.
* Strong 3D CAD modeling skills – SolidWorks proficiency is essential.
* Knowledge of design for manufacturing processes – turning, milling, welding, and sheet metal fabrication.
* Understanding of mechanical design principles and prototyping methods.
* Hands-on experience with product lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with safety standards and regulatory compliance for mechanical products.
* Technical documentation and BOM creation.
* Culture Fit: Must align with PadCare’s values – Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time; based in Pune.

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary in line with industry standards.
* **Growth Path:**
  Opportunity to scale into Design Lead and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
  Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.
* **A Culture That Cares:**
  Work in a space where collaboration, inclusivity, and purpose aren’t just values—they’re how we roll every day.

title: Principal Engineer (Clean Water Modelling)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected, and more sustainable. In our water business, that means supporting UK water companies in delivering resilient and efficient clean water networks through advanced modelling, analytics, and digital solutions.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer in Clean Water Modelling, you will play a pivotal role in delivering AMP programme outcomes, helping clients optimise network performance, enhance resilience, and meet regulatory and customer service objectives.
  
  
**Key duties include**

* Provide technical leadership in clean water network modelling across UK water utility projects.
* Lead development, calibration, and validation of hydraulic models for large-scale clean water distribution networks.
* Deliver modelling studies aligned with AMP programmes and regulatory performance requirements.
* Undertake and review

+ Demand forecasting and distribution input analysis
+ Network capacity assessments and hydraulic performance evaluations
+ Pressure management and operational optimisation studies
+ Leakage analysis and reduction strategies
+ Network resilience and outage scenario analysis

* Lead optioneering and system optimisation, including network reinforcement, rezoning, and operational improvements.
* Support development of

+ WRMP (Water Resource Management Plans) inputs
+ Investment planning and business cases (e.g., PR submissions)

* Prepare and review technical reports, modelling documentation, and analysis outputs in line with UK water industry standards.
* Ensure modelling outputs align with regulatory frameworks (OFWAT, DWI, Environment Agency).
* Establish and enforce modelling standards, QA/QC processes, and best practices.
* Perform technical assurance reviews of models, data inputs, assumptions, and outputs.
* Engage with UK water company clients, supporting model reviews, technical workshops, and decision-making discussions.
* Identify data gaps, uncertainties, and risks; define strategies for improvement and mitigation.
* Mentor and guide engineers and modellers, supporting capability development within the team.
* Drive innovation through digital tools, automation, scripting, and data-driven workflows.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects****
**.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Primary Modelling Tools InfoWorks WS Pro, Synergi
* Additional Tools (Preferred) InfoWater
* GIS Platforms ArcGIS Pro, QGIS
* Data & Analytics Advanced Excel, Power BI (desirable), Python scripting (desirable)

**Key Behaviours**

* Strong technical authority in clean water modelling and network analysis.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.
* Confident communicator with strong client engagement skills.
* Collaborative and proactive in a multidisciplinary and global delivery environment.
* High ownership of quality, data integrity, and technical excellence.
* Mentorship-driven mindset with focus on team capability development.

**Work Experience**

* Over 15 years of experience in clean water network modelling and planning, with strong focus on UK water utility projects.
* Deep expertise in InfoWorks WS Pro and/or Synergi for large-scale hydraulic modelling.
* Experience delivering modelling studies aligned with AMP cycles (AMP6/7/8).
* Strong understanding of

+ UK water industry standards and modelling practices
+ Regulatory frameworks (OFWAT, DWI, Environment Agency)
+ Asset management and investment planning processes

* Demonstrated experience in

+ Network optimisation and pressure management
+ Leakage analysis and reduction
+ Network resilience and scenario modelling

* Proven capability in technical leadership, QA/QC, and mentoring modelling teams.
* Experience in client engagement, technical reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* Experience in data analysis, interpretation, and model-driven decision support.

Familiarity with digital delivery, automation, and advanced analytics is desirable
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in Water Resources / Environmental Engineering (or relevant field)

**Preferred Attributes**

* CIWEM Accreditation
* Experience working within UK frameworks or with water utility clients
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for client-facing responsibilities.

Ability to work effectively within global delivery teams supporting UK clients.
  
  
**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Motor Claims SME – Business Acceptance Testing (BAT)
description:

**Claidroid — Pune / Thiruvananthapuram, India (Hybrid)**

**Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

**Location:**
Pune / Trivandrum

5–7 Years

**Open Positions:**

We’re Hiring: Motor Claims SME – Business Acceptance Testing

Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is hiring experienced
**Motor Claims Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)**
for a strategic Business Acceptance Testing (BAT) engagement with a leading global Insurance and Financial Services client.

We are looking for professionals with strong domain expertise in
**Motor Insurance Claims, First Notification of Loss (FNOL), Claims Registration, Liability Assessment, Survey & Inspection, Repair Management, Claims Settlement and Business Acceptance Testing**
.

The role focuses on validating business requirements, reviewing test scenarios, supporting end-to-end testing and ensuring that motor claims processes and system enhancements meet business expectations.

**This is primarily a Motor Insurance Domain SME role, not a generic software testing position.**

Candidates should possess strong functional knowledge of the motor claims lifecycle, supported by practical experience in Business Acceptance Testing (BAT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test execution and defect management.

**About Claidroid Technologies**

Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a global digital transformation and technology services partner built around
**Cloud, AI, Automation and Enterprise Platforms**
.

We work with leading enterprises to modernize technology platforms, improve operational efficiency, strengthen governance and deliver high-quality technology solutions.

Our expertise spans Insurance Technology, ServiceNow, Cloud Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Automation, DevOps, DevSecOps, Quality Engineering and Enterprise Digital Transformation.

**Role Overview**

As a
**Motor Claims SME – Business Acceptance Testing**
, you will work closely with business stakeholders, claims operations teams, Business Analysts, Developers and Quality Assurance teams to ensure that insurance claims systems and processes meet functional and operational requirements.

You will serve as the subject matter expert for Motor Claims within the BAT team, providing guidance on business processes, functional requirements, acceptance criteria and end-to-end claims workflows.

You will participate in testing new system implementations, application enhancements and production fixes, ensuring that changes accurately reflect motor insurance business requirements.

The role requires strong understanding of
**FNOL, Claims Registration, Liability Assessment, Survey & Inspection, Repair Management, Total Loss, Settlement, Recovery and Claims Controls**
.

You will also support defect investigation, business validation, UAT, production verification and test sign-off recommendations.

This role combines
**Motor Insurance Domain Expertise, Business Acceptance Testing, Business Process Validation and Quality Assurance**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Motor Claims Domain Expertise**

* Act as the Subject Matter Expert for Motor Insurance Claims within the Business Acceptance Testing team.
* Provide functional expertise across the end-to-end motor claims lifecycle.
* Analyse business requirements, change requests and functional specifications related to Motor Claims.
* Validate business rules, process flows and expected system behaviour.
* Support claims-related business process improvements and system enhancements.
* Provide functional guidance to Business Analysts, Testers, Developers and project stakeholders.
* Ensure business requirements accurately reflect operational claims processes.

**Business Acceptance Testing (BAT)**

* Review and validate test scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure adequate test coverage across Motor Claims business processes.
* Execute Business Acceptance Testing for new implementations, enhancements and production fixes.
* Validate system functionality against defined business requirements.
* Identify discrepancies between expected and actual system behaviour.
* Support end-to-end business process testing across interconnected claims activities.
* Document testing observations, defects and business-impact assessments.
* Provide recommendations for business acceptance and testing sign-off.

**End-to-End Motor Claims Process Validation**

Validate business workflows covering:

* **First Notification of Loss (FNOL):**
  Claim initiation and loss notification processes.
* **Claims Registration:**
  Claim creation, registration and validation.
* **Liability Assessment:**
  Evaluation of claim liability and business rules.
* **Survey & Inspection:**
  Surveyor activities, inspections and damage assessments.
* **Repair Management:**
  Repair authorization, repair workflows and associated processes.
* **Total Loss Management:**
  Total loss assessment and related claims processing.
* **Claims Settlement:**
  Settlement calculations, approvals and payments.
* **Claims Recovery:**
  Recovery processes and associated controls.
* **Fraud Detection:**
  Fraud indicators, validation checks and claims controls.
* **Claim Closure:**
  Final validation and closure of claims.

**Defect Management & Business Validation**

* Identify, document and track functional defects during testing.
* Analyse defects from a Motor Insurance business-process perspective.
* Collaborate with business and IT teams to investigate and resolve issues.
* Participate in defect triage meetings and solution discussions.
* Validate defect fixes and confirm alignment with business expectations.
* Communicate the business impact of identified defects.
* Support timely resolution of testing issues.

**UAT, Production Verification & Quality Assurance**

* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities when required.
* Participate in Production Verification Testing following system changes.
* Validate that implemented solutions meet expected business outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and business standards.
* Prepare test execution reports and defect summaries.
* Provide inputs for business acceptance and release-readiness decisions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of BAT processes and testing practices.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Documentation**

* Participate in requirement walkthroughs and functional discussions.
* Collaborate with Motor Claims business teams, operations, technology and QA stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into clear test scenarios and validation criteria.
* Explain complex claims processes to technical and non-technical team members.
* Maintain documentation relating to test results, defects and functional observations.
* Communicate testing progress, risks and outstanding issues.
* Support effective coordination between business and technology teams.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Motor Insurance Claims Domain**

* **5–7 years of relevant experience**
  , with strong knowledge of Motor Insurance Claims processes.
* Thorough understanding of the end-to-end Motor Claims lifecycle.
* Expertise in First Notification of Loss (FNOL).
* Strong understanding of Claims Registration and Validation.
* Knowledge of Liability Assessment.
* Familiarity with Survey and Inspection processes.
* Understanding of Repair Management and Total Loss Management.
* Knowledge of Claims Settlement and Recovery.
* Understanding of Fraud Detection and Claims Controls.
* Awareness of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to Motor Claims.

**Business Acceptance Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Good understanding of Business Acceptance Testing (BAT).
* Experience with User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Ability to review and validate test scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Experience executing business acceptance tests.
* Understanding of end-to-end business process testing.
* Experience in defect identification, tracking and resolution.
* Ability to validate system functionality against business requirements.
* Experience preparing test reports and defect summaries.

**Testing Tools & Delivery Methodologies**

* Familiarity with JIRA, Azure DevOps, ALM or equivalent test and defect management tools.
* Experience working in Agile and/or Waterfall delivery environments.
* Understanding of software change management and testing processes.
* Ability to collaborate with development teams during defect resolution and retesting.

**Professional Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent business communication and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to collaborate with business, operations and technology teams.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Capability to independently investigate business-process discrepancies.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an added advantage:

* **Insurance Operations:**
  Experience working within insurance organizations handling Motor Claims.
* **Claims Transformation:**
  Participation in claims platform modernization or transformation projects.
* **Claims Management Systems:**
  Exposure to enterprise insurance claims processing platforms.
* **Policy Administration Systems:**
  Understanding of policy data and its relationship with claims processes.
* **Business Analysis:**
  Experience analysing business requirements and functional specifications.
* **Quality Assurance:**
  Previous experience in BAT, UAT or QA roles.
* **Insurance Certifications:**
  Relevant insurance-domain qualifications or certifications.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for
**experienced Motor Claims professionals who combine deep insurance-domain expertise with strong business validation and testing capabilities**
.

The ideal candidate should have:

* 5–7 years of relevant experience with strong exposure to Motor Insurance Claims.
* Comprehensive knowledge of FNOL, Claims Registration, Liability Assessment, Repair Management and Claims Settlement.
* Experience validating motor claims workflows and business rules.
* Understanding of Business Acceptance Testing and User Acceptance Testing.
* Ability to review functional specifications, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Experience investigating defects and validating system changes.
* Strong ability to collaborate with business users, claims operations and IT teams.
* Excellent analytical, communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned business validation activities.

Candidates should have a graduate degree in any discipline.

Insurance-related certifications will be an added advantage.

This opportunity is particularly suitable for professionals with experience in
**Motor Claims Operations, Insurance Business Analysis, Claims System Testing, Business Acceptance Testing or Insurance Technology Transformation**
.

**Why Join Claidroid Technologies?**

At Claidroid Technologies, you will work on enterprise technology initiatives for global clients in an environment that values domain expertise, quality, collaboration and continuous improvement.

This role provides exposure to:

* Motor Insurance Claims Lifecycle
* Business Acceptance Testing (BAT)
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* FNOL & Claims Registration

* Repair & Total Loss Management

You will collaborate with experienced insurance-domain specialists, business teams and technology professionals while contributing to the quality and reliability of enterprise claims systems.

Work Location & Hybrid Working Model

**Pune / Trivandrum – Hybrid**

This position offers a flexible hybrid working arrangement, with
**office attendance required only on a need basis**
.

Candidates may work remotely and should be willing to attend the designated office location in Pune or Trivandrum when required for business meetings, project activities or collaboration.

**Apply Now**

If you have strong expertise in
**Motor Insurance Claims, FNOL, Claims Settlement, Business Acceptance Testing and Insurance Business Processes**
, we would like to hear from you.

Join Claidroid Technologies and contribute to improving the reliability, quality and business effectiveness of enterprise Motor Claims systems.

description:

EXP: 10 to 14 Years

title: Busines Debelpment Manager - Jewellery Industry
description:
**Company Description**
Instalaxmi is the country’s first and largest B2B Digital Gold company, building specialized platforms for jewelry businesses. The company develops digital gold solutions that help jewelers offer modern, technology-driven products to their customers. Its platforms include important features such as loyalty programs and gamified experiences designed around consumer behavior. By enhancing app engagement and user experience, Instalaxmi supports partners in driving higher usage and business growth. The organization focuses on innovation in the digital gold and jewelry ecosystem, creating tools that are practical, scalable, and easy to use.

**Role Description**
The Business Development Manager – Jewellery Industry will be responsible for identifying and acquiring new jewelry business partners, primarily in and around Pune City, and nurturing long-term relationships with existing clients. This full-time, on-site role involves conducting market research, meeting with jewelers, presenting Instalaxmi’s digital gold and loyalty solutions, and negotiating commercial terms. The role includes collaborating with internal product and marketing teams to tailor platform offerings, support onboarding, and ensure smooth implementation for clients. The manager will track sales pipelines, prepare regular business reports, and proactively seek opportunities to expand product usage and cross-sell features. Regular field visits, participation in industry events, and staying updated on jewelry and digital gold trends are core parts of the day-to-day work.

**Qualifications**

* Strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, client acquisition, and negotiation within B2B environments.
* Experience or familiarity with the jewellery industry, financial products, or digital platforms, with the ability to understand jeweler and consumer needs.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to build trust-based relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to perform market research, analyze data, and prepare concise reports and business proposals.
* Comfort with technology and digital platforms, including CRM tools, mobile apps, and basic productivity software.
* Proactive, self-motivated work style, with strong time management and organizational skills for on-site client engagement.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in business development, sales, or account management, preferably in jewellery, fintech, or related sectors.
* Willingness to work on-site in Pune City and travel locally as needed for client meetings and market visits.

* Independently design and develop electronic hardware for Industrial Applications such as Electric Actuators.
* Design analog, digital, and mixed ‑ signal circuits including microcontroller systems, sensor interfaces, power supplies, and signal conditioning.

* Lead in schematic design, component selection, PCB layout, tolerance stack ‑ up, and routing considerations.
* Perform prototype hardware start ‑ up, debugging, and functional/performance validation.
* Conduct detailed analysis and resolution of hardware issues during development and testing phases.

* Mentor junior engineers in hardware design practices, debugging techniques, and documentation.

* BE / Equivalent in Industrial Electronics / Electronics and Telecommunication with 8 to 12 years of experience in Electronics Hardware Design and Development.

* Good understanding of control electronics, signal integrity, grounding, and isolation techniques.
* Experience with communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, CAN, RS485, RS232, Ethernet, or USB.

* Respond to employee inquiries regarding pay, deductions, and tax with professionalism and accuracy.
* Prepare and submit payroll-related reports (tax filings, compliance reports, etc.).
* Collaborate with HR and Finance teams on benefits, deductions, and compensation changes.
* Assist in year-end activities such as Quarterly/Annual return preparation and tax reconciliations.
* Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and participate in payroll system upgrades or implementations.

* 5 to 7 years of experience in Payroll management, Compliance & hands on experience in HRMS project
* Experience with automated payroll systems and integrations.
* Familiarity with labor laws and statutory compliance.
* Ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
* Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.

* Support deployment, hypercare, issue resolution, and transition to support organizations.

title: Founder's Office Associate
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a sharp, multi-disciplinary Graduate Associate to work directly with the Founder. In the MEP industry, projects move fast and require a mix of technical precision and commercial savvy. You will act as the "right hand" to the leadership, helping transition the firm from engineering concepts to market-leading execution. * Graphic Design & Branding: Take ownership of the firm’s visual identity. You will design brand decks, technical brochures, and high-impact project portfolios for client meetings.

**The Profile we are looking for**

* Educational Background: A recent degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (preferred) or Business/Architecture with a strong interest in the built environment.
* The "Swiss Army Knife" Mindset: You are equally comfortable reading a technical floor plan as you are designing a logo or building a spreadsheet.
* Software Savvy:
* Engineering: Awareness of AutoCAD or Revit (BIM) is a plus.
* Design: Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Illustrator or Figma.
* Data: Advanced Excel skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, basic macros).
* Tech: Proficient in using AI technology to generate results.
* Communication: Exceptional writing skills to draft "Nearby Engineers" style documentation and professional correspondence.

**What is in it for you?**

* Direct Mentorship: Work daily with the Founder, gaining insights that usually take 10 years to acquire.

* Impact: Your research and designs will be the face of the firm in front of developers and architects.

This is a dynamic role, beyond the listed responsibilities, you will be expected to step in and own any high-priority tasks as needed.

title: MQ Security Specialist (Pune, Bangalore)
description:
We are seeking an MQ Security Specialist to lead security integration for IBM MQ for z/OS during the ACF2 to RACF migration. This role will ensure MQ queue manager, queue, channel, listener, CHINIT, command, process, namelist, service ID, certificate, TLS, and secure messaging controls are converted, validated, and operationalized without disrupting critical business messaging flows.

**Key Skills and Expertise**

**L2:**
Key skills include IBM MQ for z/OS, ACF2 MQ rules, RACF MQ classes, queue manager security, queue authorities, channel security, CHINIT, listeners, MQ command and object security, certificate and TLS controls, keyrings, started tasks, service IDs, application and batch integrations, MQ logs, SMF, channel messages, message flow validation, and regression testing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own MQ security conversion design from ACF2 rules to RACF profiles, groups, permits, and MQ class-specific controls.
* Define RACF controls for MQ queue managers, queues, channels, processes, namelists, listeners, CHINIT, commands, and administration functions.
* Validate MQ started task IDs, queue manager IDs, CHINIT IDs, service IDs, application IDs, surrogate access, and batch integration authorities.
* Coordinate digital certificate, keyring, TLS, channel security, and secure messaging access with the infrastructure and RACF engineering leads.
* Review MQ object authorities, channel configuration, listener setup, CHINIT controls, and connection flows for migration impact.
* Lead MQ regression testing, connectivity testing, message flow validation, channel authorization testing, and negative authorization testing.
* Troubleshoot MQ authorization failures using RACF messages, MQ logs, SMF records, channel messages, and application diagnostics.
* Coordinate application owner sign-off for MQ workloads in each migration wave.

* Strong knowledge of IBM MQ for z/OS security in RACF or ACF2 environments.
* Experience supporting critical production messaging workloads in regulated environments.

title: VP - BA Client Journey Execution
description:

In this role, you will work in close partnership with Product Owners and Technology teams to shape and deliver market‑leading digital products and client journeys, ensuring solutions are customer‑centric, scalable, and aligned to regulatory, operational, and strategic priorities. This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

description:
**About Dataction**
Dataction is a new age services firm that offers best in class information technology, analytics, and consulting services to renowned international companies. Our people are committed, courageous, and unafraid of pushing boundaries. They help our clients make decisions that deliver immediate and measurable benefits, justifying investments. Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.
  
  
To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Hyper-V Infrastructure Engineer to build the target Microsoft Hyper-V platform and migrate our client's server workloads off VMware safely and on schedule. The client's VMware licences expire in November 2026, so this is a time-critical, hands-on delivery role. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the server workload migration on HPE ProLiant hosts: ~100 production server VMs (TAG cluster) and a single-host backup recovery cluster moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Microsoft Hyper-V. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect service continuity throughout, work closely with the VDI/XenServer workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft Hyper-V Platform Build & Hardening

+ Build, configure, and harden Hyper-V hosts (Windows Server 2019/2022 Datacenter) on HPE ProLiant hardware, including iLO, firmware/SPP, and driver compliance.
+ Design and deploy Hyper-V Failover Clusters: Cluster Shared Volumes, quorum/witness, live migration, and Switch Embedded Teaming.
+ Configure virtual networking (Hyper-V virtual switches, VLANs, SET/NIC teaming) and SAN storage connectivity (iSCSI/FC, MPIO) to match the existing VMware design.
+ Deploy and configure management tooling (SCVMM and/or Windows Admin Center), including host groups, logical networks, VM templates, and role-based access.
+ Stand up the Hyper-V environment for ~100 production server VMs (TAG cluster) and the single-host recovery environment.
+ Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.

* Server Workload Migration (VMware Exit)

+ Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 server estate (clusters, VM inventory, application dependencies, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and cutover schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
+ Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as Hyper-V, migrate workloads, and repeat, using spare cluster capacity to avoid disruption.
+ Convert and migrate VMs using appropriate V2V tooling (e.g. SCVMM, Windows Admin Center VM Conversion, Veeam restore to Hyper-V), including VMware Tools removal, Integration Services, Generation 1/2 decisions, and network/IP re-mapping.
+ Plan and execute a safe approach for the single-host recovery cluster, where no spare capacity exists.
+ Define test, validation, and rollback procedures for each cutover, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and application owner sign-off with the client.
+ Decommission VMware hosts once workloads are verified and signed off.

* Backup, Resilience & Security

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:

This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
  
  
Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

* Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. title: Senior Citrix XenServer & VDI Engineer
description:
**About Dataction**
Dataction is a new age services firm that offers best in class information technology, analytics, and consulting services to renowned international companies. Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.
  
  
To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Citrix XenServer & VDI Engineer to build the target Citrix XenServer platform and migrate our client's VDI estate off VMware safely and on schedule. The client's VMware licences expire in November 2026, so this is a time-critical, hands-on delivery role. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the VDI migration across 10 HPE ProLiant hosts: ~400 VDI desktops moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Citrix XenServer. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect the end-user experience throughout, work closely with the client's Citrix team and the Hyper-V workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Citrix XenServer Platform Build & Management

+ Build and configure Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor hosts and resource pools on HPE ProLiant hardware (10 hosts), including iLO, firmware/SPP, and hardware compatibility compliance.
+ Configure storage repositories (iSCSI/FC/NFS with multipathing), NIC bonding, networks/VLANs, and pool HA to match the existing VMware design.
+ Manage the estate via XenCenter and the xe CLI, including pool master design, Active Directory integration, role-based access, and host update/hotfix lifecycle.
+ Size and tune pool capacity (CPU, memory, storage IOPS, read caching) for ~400 concurrent desktops.
+ Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.

* Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops Integration

+ Work with the client's Citrix team to create hosting connections and resources from the Delivery Controllers to the new XenServer pools.
+ Prepare and optimise golden images for XenServer (XenServer VM Tools, Citrix VDA, Citrix Optimizer) and rebuild machine catalogs using MCS/PVS.
+ Validate machine catalog and delivery group configuration, power management, and provisioning behaviour after each stage.
+ Validate VDI performance, user logon experience, profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management), and capacity after each stage of the migration.

* VDI Migration Planning & Execution (VMware Exit)

+ Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 VDI estate (hosts, catalogs, golden images, persistent vs non-persistent desktops, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
+ Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as XenServer, move desktop capacity in phases by delivery group/user population, and repeat, avoiding disruption to users.
+ Rebuild non-persistent catalogs from new XenServer golden images and convert persistent desktops using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or other V2V tooling, including VMware Tools removal and XenServer VM Tools installation.
+ Define pilot, UAT, validation, and rollback procedures for each stage, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and user communications with the client.
+ Decommission VMware hosts once desktops are verified and signed off.

* Security, Automation & Handover

+ Apply security hardening to XenServer hosts and golden images aligned to CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Security Baselines, and vendor guidance.
+ Establish patching and lifecycle processes for XenServer hosts, VDAs, and golden images.
+ Automate repetitive build, image, and migration tasks using PowerShell (Citrix PowerShell SDK, XenServer SDK) and the xe CLI.
+ Produce build documentation, runbooks, and operational handover for the client's infrastructure and Citrix teams, and brief them on day-to-day management.
+ Coordinate with the Hyper-V server workstream on shared hardware, networks, storage, and the overall migration schedule.

**Qualification, Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in virtualisation and end-user computing / VDI infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor, including host builds, resource pools, storage repositories, multipathing, NIC bonding, pool HA, XenCenter, and the xe CLI.
* Strong experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, including Delivery Controllers, hosting connections, machine catalogs, delivery groups, and MCS/PVS.
* Proven experience running VDI at scale (400+ desktops), including golden image build, optimisation, and VDA lifecycle management.
* Proven experience migrating VDI workloads between hypervisors with minimal user disruption, using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or image-rebuild approaches.
* Good understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi 7.x/8.x, including vCenter, VMware Tools removal, and host decommissioning.
* Hands-on experience with HPE ProLiant servers, including iLO, firmware/SPP compliance, and Smart Array configuration.
* Good understanding of storage and SAN technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, and multipathing, and storage performance/IOPS sizing for VDI.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, LACP/NIC bonding, switching, firewalls, and Citrix HDX/ICA traffic.
* Strong experience with Windows 10/11 desktop and Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management.
* Experience with user profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management) and VDI performance and logon troubleshooting using Citrix Director or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting (including the Citrix PowerShell SDK) for automation, administration, and migration tasks.
* Experience implementing security baselines and hardening standards for hosts and golden images, and managing patching across hypervisors and desktops.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across XenServer, Citrix, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers.
* Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical solutions, operational procedures, and handover material.
* Exposure to Microsoft Hyper-V or Citrix DaaS / Citrix Cloud is desirable.
* Prior VMware exit / hypervisor replatforming project experience is desirable.
* Relevant certifications are desirable: Citrix (CCA-V / CCP-V) or VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV).

title: Lead Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Lead Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Oracle RAC**
**Self-Managed Oracle RAC | HA/DR | Performance | Automation | Engineering Influence**
**Level**
Lead DBRE
  
  
**Domain**
Oracle RAC and Mission-Critical Relational Infrastructure
  
  
**Primary Focus**
Hands-on Oracle RAC reliability, lifecycle ownership, technical escalation, automation, application partnership, and cross-functional execution
  
  
**Work Expectations**
U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required
  
  

* Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead DBRE with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Database and self-managed Oracle RAC environments. The role owns technical execution for a major Oracle domain and improves reliability, performance, scalability, lifecycle management, automation, and operational discipline.
  
  
Beyond traditional DBA operations, the Lead DBRE partners with application and infrastructure teams to influence schema, SQL, connection management, resiliency, observability, and safe deployment practices. The role remains hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and incident escalation.
  
  

* Level Scope and Leadership Expectations

Lead DBRE is a senior technical leadership role focused on owning execution for a major database domain. The expectation is to solve difficult production problems, lead initiatives end to end, guide engineers, create durable operating standards, and drive cross-functional closure without default people-management responsibility.
  
  
**Dimension**
**Expectation at This Level**
**Scope of Ownership**
Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements.
  
  
**Technical Depth**
Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems.
  
  
**Technical Leadership**
Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions.
  
  
**Execution**
Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure.
  
  
**Communication**
Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible.
  
  
**Automation and Standards**
Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Oracle RAC Platform Ownership
* Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations.
* Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices.
* Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures.
* Performance and Incident Leadership
* Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics.
* Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability
* Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior.
* Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards.
* Automation and Observability
* Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives.
* Required Qualifications and Experience
* 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior.
* Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change.
* Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience.
* Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities.
* Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling.
* Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials.
* Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months
* Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement.
* Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability.
* Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams.
* Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments.
* What This Role Does Not Include
* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership.
* This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on.
* This is not a traditional DBA ticket queue; durable fixes, automation, standards, capacity planning, and reliability improvements are expected.
* This role does not own application code or business logic, although it influences database-impacting application design.
* The role does not assume unlimited or last-minute DBRE capacity; work must be planned, prioritized, communicated, and committed through the appropriate process.
* Work Expectations and Location

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Senior Escalation Engineering (ThousandEyes)
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco ThousandEyes is a Digital Experience Assurance platform that empowers organizations to deliver flawless digital experiences across every network - even the ones they don’t own. The Customer Engineering team helps customers diagnose service problems, use ThousandEyes effectively, and improve digital experience reliability. Lead complex, high-impact customer investigations through chat, email, phone, and scheduled 24-hour support coverage so customers can restore service quickly. Use logs, tests, network data, and product behavior to identify likely causes when information is incomplete. Coordinate escalations with Engineering and Product, providing clear evidence and recommended next steps to drive timely fixes. Create scripts, automation, and reusable documentation to reduce repeated work and improve resolution consistency. Mentor engineers and represent Customer Engineering in product reviews and customer meetings to improve support quality and product usability.

* Bachelor’s degree and 12 years experience in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related technical field; Masters and 8 years related technical experience; PhD and 5 years of related technical experience

* 3+ years of experience troubleshooting cloud services, software-as-a-service products, internet services, or enterprise applications using logs, monitoring data, network traces, or test environments.
* 2+ years of experience independently leading investigations of customer technical issues, including documenting findings, escalating issues in writing, and driving issues through resolution or documented handoff.
* Experience troubleshooting at least three of the following: Domain Name System, web traffic using HTTP or HTTPS, Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol, routing, proxy servers, authentication, or single sign-on.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a cloud-based monitoring, network, or digital experience product.
* Experience writing automation scripts in Python, Java, or a comparable language, and using application programming interfaces to automate workflows.
* Experience administering Linux systems and using containers or virtual machines.
* Cisco CCIE certification or another advanced networking or cloud certification.
* Experience writing customer-facing technical documentation and mentoring engineers across teams.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced IP Core Network Specialist to provide expert-level technical support, incident management, fault resolution, and service restoration across complex IP/MPLS, transport, and optical network environments. This role is ideal for a network professional with strong experience in service provider networks, customer-facing technical escalations, and multi-vendor technologies including Nokia, Huawei, and Cisco platforms. * IS-IS
* BGP
* MPLS L2VPN / L3VPN
* Segment Routing (SR-MPLS)
* Traffic Engineering (SR-TE / MPLS-TE)

* Create and maintain troubleshooting documentation, knowledge articles, and operational procedures
* Mentor Level 1 engineers and act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME)
* Contribute to continuous improvement activities and technical enablement

**Experience**
**Who you are**

* 6 to 8 years of experience within Telecom, ISP, or Service Provider environments
* Strong background in Network Operations, Incident Management, and Service Assurance
* Experience managing customer-facing technical escalations
* Proven expertise in troubleshooting complex multi-vendor IP/MPLS networks

Technical Expertise
  
  
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in:
  
  

* IS-IS
* BGP
* MPLS
* Segment Routing
* Traffic Engineering
* Multicast technologies
* IPv4 / IPv6
* QoS

Experience supporting service provider equipment from Nokia, Huawei, and Cisco.
  
  
Personal Attributes
  
  

* Strong ownership and accountability for service outcomes
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to remain composed and make effective decisions during critical incidents
* Effective stakeholder and customer engagement skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
* Ability to influence technical outcomes and collaborate across multiple teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCNP Service Provider or Enterprise

Success Measures

* SLA Achievement

* Knowledge Management Contributions
* Operational Improvement Initiatives

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

title: Community Partnerships & Growth Executive
description:
Tavasyam Life | Commission-Based | Remote / Pune, India
  
  
(
**Kindly Apply By Filling-in The Application Form Only. Link Is Provided At The Bottom**
)
  
  
**About Tavasyam Life**
Tavasyam Life is a health and fitness coaching company focused on helping people build lasting strength, stamina, mobility and healthier habits.
  
  
We offer personalized online coaching and structured group fitness programs. We are currently expanding our Women's Group Coaching Program in India and the Netherlands.
  
  
Our three-month program combines live, coach-led home workouts three times a week with strength training, aerobic conditioning, animal movements, yoga flows, breathwork, mobility drills and practical nutrition guidance.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a proactive, relationship-driven individual to help expand Tavasyam's reach through community partnerships, institutional relationships and distribution channels.
  
  
This is not a sales-calling or customer-closing role.
  
  
We want someone who can build a repeatable customer acquisition network rather than simply post promotional content online.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
1.
**Community & Society Partnerships**
\* Identify and approach residential societies, apartment associations, women's groups and community organizations.
  
  
\* Build relationships with society committees, resident welfare associations and community administrators.
  
  
\* Secure opportunities to promote Tavasyam's programs within relevant communities.
  
  
\* Organize introductions and opportunities for women's fitness workshops, wellness sessions and group coaching enrollment.
  
  
2.
**Corporate & Institutional Partnerships**
\* Identify opportunities with IT companies, HR teams, employee engagement teams, coworking spaces and corporate wellness initiatives.
  
  
\* Establish relationships with relevant decision-makers.
  
  
\* Secure permission to share program information, conduct introductory workshops or offer group coaching to employees.
  
  
\* Develop a pipeline of organizations that can provide recurring access to potential participants.
  
  
3.
**Lead Generation & Distribution**
\* Identify relevant women's communities, online groups, local networks and referral partners.
  
  
\* Develop permission-based distribution opportunities for Tavasyam's program announcements.
  
  
\* Generate qualified enquiries and maintain accurate records of their source.
  
  
\* Coordinate with the founders to ensure enquiries are followed up promptly.
  
  
\* Explore referral partnerships with complementary businesses and community organizers.
  
  
4.
**Partnership Development**
\* Maintain a structured pipeline of prospective partners, outreach activity, meetings, agreements and outcomes.
  
  
\* Test different partnership approaches and report which channels generate genuine enquiries and paid enrollments.
  
  
\* Build repeatable processes that can be expanded across Pune and other Indian cities.
  
  
\* Explore opportunities to support Tavasyam's Netherlands expansion through local communities and organizations.
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
\* Experience in partnerships, business development, community management, field marketing or distribution.
  
  
\* Strong relationship-building and communication skills.
  
  
\* Confidence approaching people and organizations to establish new partnerships.
  
  
\* Ability to research and identify relevant communities and decision-makers.
  
  
\* A proactive, resourceful and results-oriented working style.
  
  
\* Ability to work independently and maintain a structured pipeline of opportunities.
  
  
\* Existing relationships with residential societies, women's communities, HR teams or corporate networks are a significant advantage.
  
  
Experience in fitness, wellness, healthcare, consumer services or community-led businesses would be helpful.
  
  
We care more about your ability to build productive partnerships than your formal qualifications.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
\* Relevant communities and organizations approached.
  
  
\* Genuine partnerships established.
  
  
\* Permission secured to conduct workshops or distribute program information.
  
  
\* Qualified enquiries generated through identifiable channels.
  
  
\* Paid enrollments attributable to those partnerships.
  
  
\* Repeatable channels that can continue generating opportunities.
  
  
We value actual outcomes over impressions, follower counts or the number of messages sent.
  
  
**Compensation & Engagement**
This is an initial 30-day, performance-based engagement with no fixed salary.
  
  
Compensation will be linked to measurable results, with the commission structure agreed upon in writing before work begins.
  
  
The initial focus will be on establishing partnerships and generating enquiries for our Women's Group Coaching Program. Additional incentives may be considered for paid enrollments and partnerships that generate recurring business.
  
  
Any approved travel or event expenses will be discussed in advance.
  
  
This opportunity is best suited to someone who is comfortable with performance-linked compensation and wants to build a long-term association with a growing health and fitness brand.
  
  
**How to Apply**
Please fill-in the form - https://form.jotform.com/tavasyamlife/tavasyam-life--community-partnershi
  
  
Tavasyam Life — Strength for Life.

Manager, Product Management

Mastercard Merchant Cloud and Acceptance represent core strategic priorities for the Asia Pacific region. The individual will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Product, Operations, Delivery, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and other internal partners—to drive execution and deliver strategic outcomes.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the identification and assessment of potential opportunities for Merchant Cloud across APAC through data analysis and insight generation.
* Conduct customer segmentation and lifecycle analysis to identify indicators of expansion, cross-sell, or product adoption potential
* Analyze transaction characteristics and market data to support identification of relevant customer segments
* Develop and maintain analytical frameworks and reporting models including opportunity sizing approaches, funnel and conversion analytics, and pipeline coverage metrics for internal monitoring and decision-support purposes.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Vice President, Product Design
description:
**Job Description**
**Vice President, Product Designer**
We're seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Product Designer, AI Hub to join our Digital Channels team. This role is based in Pune.
  
  
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Make complexity clear - Take systems that are genuinely hard: multi-step workflows, cross-platform journeys, enterprise-scale data. Design experiences that make sense to the people who depend on them. Understand the problem at depth before touching anything.
* Drive concept development from day one - Bring ideas from research and outcomes to prototyped form fast. Demonstrate possibilities rather than describing them. Use AI-assisted tools to close the distance between design intent and working experience.
* Own the design of end-to-end experiences - Map journeys across users, teams, and systems. Identify where things break, where friction accumulates, and what needs to be rebuilt versus refined. Operate across the full scope of a platform experience, not just the screens in front of you.
* Contribute to a design system built for how design works now - Our design system is structured as machine-readable infrastructure, not just a component library. Tokens carry semantic meaning. Patterns encode reasoning about when and why they apply. AI agents consume it directly alongside human developers. Contributing here means adding to the grammar, not just the vocabulary, and understanding why that distinction matters.
* Communicate design as a point of view, not a deliverable - Articulate the rationale behind decisions. Help product managers and engineers understand the tradeoffs. Make design legible to people who don't speak design, without dumbing it down.
* Mentor through example. Raise the standard of work around you through critique, collaboration, and how you approach problems. Not through title.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Bring The Following Expertise**

* Typically, 10 -14 years of experience, or equivalent demonstrated through portfolio and impact.
* Strong product design fundamentals: research synthesis, interaction design, systems thinking, visual craft
* Experience designing complex systems: enterprise software, multi-step workflows, data-heavy interfaces
* Demonstrated comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the problem isn't handed to you pre-formed
* The ability to communicate design rationale to mixed audiences (product, engineering, business) and hold your perspective under pressure

**Preferred**

* You already work with AI-assisted tools, not just for ideation, but for building and prototyping
* You've worked in shared codebases or repos with cross-functional teams, or you're actively moving in that direction
* You can describe a moment when AI changed how you approached a design problem, not made it faster, but made it \*different\*
* You've contributed to a design system at the pattern or systems level, not just component execution

**What Will Set You Apart**

* You work at the intersection of design and technical implementation, close to the material, not downstream from it
* You've felt the industry shift happening and leaned toward it
* Your process produces things, not documents

You have a deep excitement for and understanding of the opportunity that AI creates for design, even if you haven't fully arrived there yet, you're moving fast
  
  
**A portfolio is required, but what we most want to see may not look like a traditional design portfolio.**
The most compelling thing you can share is evidence of how you actually create products: working alongside product managers and engineers in real time, from research to something shippable, in a way that reflects how modern product teams operate. Show us a process, a repo, a prototype you built directly, a decision you influenced in the room. If you've worked in a shared codebase or repo with cross-functional partners, bring that to life. If you've used AI tools to get from insight to working experience faster, bring that to life.
  
  
Beyond that, we want to see what you'd expect: complex systems thinking, end-to-end journey work, evidence of design decisions that improved the experience and why. Figma files, PDFs, personal sites, live products: format doesn't matter. Show us the work that best reflects how you think and what you shaped.
  
  
**About Us**
At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
  
  
Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Senior Engineering Technician – Local AI Automation
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
The Local AI Automation team is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Technician to help scale and sustain a reliable automation lab supporting AI development and validation. You will take a leading role in system bring-up, lab operations, maintenance, issue resolution, and multi-functional coordination to help ensure infrastructure readiness and operational excellence. If you are passionate about building and maintaining reliable Local AI systems and lab infrastructure, this is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact!
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Set up, cable, configure, and maintain Local AI systems and supporting application and data servers across Windows and Linux environments.
* Partner with infrastructure teams to coordinate lab space, power, network connectivity, site readiness, and system deployment.
* Support procurement activities by defining requirements, coordinating with vendors, tracking inventory, and preparing systems for internal and external users.
* Collaborate with others to gain a clear understanding of hardware and software requirements. Bring online Local AI PCs and desktop systems. Deploy operating system images, install required tools, and support software.
* Monitor lab health and key operational metrics, restore unavailable systems, and help ensure reliable lab infrastructure.
* Investigate recurring issues, perform root cause analysis for system downtime, and partner with collaborators to implement corrective actions and automation improvements.
* Maintain lab safety, cleanliness, organization, and documentation standards.

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech or a diploma/degree in computer science, information technology, electronics, or a related field—or equivalent hands-on experience—with 4+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience supporting lab operations, system bring-up, GPU-based Local AI PCs and desktop systems, and the backend and data server setup used for hosting applications.
* Hands-on experience installing, upgrading, resolving problems, and maintaining Local AI PCs and desktop systems, in addition to application and database server environments, including GPUs, memory, storage, and firmware, using established technical procedures and documentation.
* Experience deploying and bringing up Local AI PCs and desktop systems. This includes operating system imaging, configuration, and validation. It also includes supporting servers that host applications and databases for software deployment.
* Demonstrable understanding of desktop and server environments including Windows OS and Linux distributions, along with foundational networking concepts.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and multi-functional partnership skills.
* Ability to work independently, handle operational issues, and coordinate alongside collaborators to drive timely resolution.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience with hardware bring-up, debugging, and failure isolation for Local AI PCs and desktop systems, as well as servers supporting software deployment and data management.
* Familiarity with lab health monitoring, downtime analysis, and root cause investigation.
* Scripting or automation experience using Python, Bash, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks with minimal direction in prototype or fast-paced engineering environments.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a hands-on technician who thrives in fast-paced engineering environments, we’d like to hear from you.
