title: Administer and support Oracle/ PostgreSQL- Associate Director,
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
CIB MSS Securities Services (SSV) Infrastructure Team is responsible for delivery of IT infrastructure needs for SSv business needs globally. The current team has strong infrastructure skills and experience across our globally distributed SMEs spread across (Canada, U.K, India and HongKong). To maintain our professional level of Database Administration and Automation service, we need an individual who should possess a strong blend of development tooling experience and methodologies, coupled with an awareness of infrastructure technologies and ITIL processes.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Administer and support Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms across development, test and production environments, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, backup and recovery, monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Design and implement infrastructure automation solutions in line with Group standards for database and platform operations, including provisioning, configuration, patching, health checks, capacity reporting, and vulnerability remediation.
* Support Oracle high-availability and disaster-recovery technologies, including RAC, Data Guard, and multitenant architecture, as well as relevant PostgreSQL resilience and recovery solutions.
* Investigate database and automation-service incidents, lead technical troubleshooting where required, identify root causes, and implement sustainable preventive measures.
* Develop reusable, production-ready scripts and automation workflows using Rundeck, Ansible, and related tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, and GitHub, with appropriate testing, logging, error handling, security controls, and documentation.
* Partner with infrastructure, application, security, and service-management teams to integrate automation into operational processes and improve service resilience.
* Maintain technical documentation, automation runbooks, and support procedures, and contribute to knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and a strong engineering culture.

**To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* At least 10 years’ hands-on experience in database administration, with strong expertise in Oracle and PostgreSQL, including installation, configuration, monitoring, patching, upgrades, backup and recovery, performance tuning, troubleshooting, high availability, disaster recovery and resilience. Practical experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard and multitenant architecture is required.
* Experience with Delphix, Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Exadata and cloud technologies is advantageous. Good working knowledge of Unix/Linux and Windows platforms, enterprise monitoring, job scheduling and storage technologies, including tools such as BMC Patrol and Control-M, as well as SAN environments.
* Familiarity with approved AI-assisted development or operational tools is required. Good understanding ofthe business benefits, limitations and potential risks of AI technologies.
* Demonstrable experience in designing, developing, testing and supporting infrastructure automation solutions, with strong hands-on experience in Rundeck and/or Ansible, plus knowledge of at least one additional tool such as GitHub, Grafana, Jenkins or HashiCorp Vault.
* Good coding and scripting capability in Python, Shell, PowerShell, SQL and Git, together with experience integrating with APIs and the ability to create maintainable, reusable and production-ready infrastructure automation.
* Practical experience in incident, crisis and problem management, including root-cause analysis, risk-based decision-making and the implementation of preventive measures.
* Strong ownership, a sense of urgency, analytical and communication skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to processes, security, compliance and operational controls.

title: System Administrator
description:
Hello! At
**ESTECO**
we are always seeking talented and motivated people who want to work with us. We are looking for a
**System Administrator**
to look after day-to-day IT operations in our
**Pune**
office.

You will be the local IT reference point for colleagues in India. You will handle first-level support on your own and work closely with our HQ IT team on the systems that are managed centrally.

This role suits someone with solid hands-on experience who wants to grow in an international environment. You'll follow established procedures, take ownership of your tasks and suggest improvements where you see them.

**Location:**
Pune, India (on-site)

**Experience:**
2–3 years

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**What you will do**

**End-user support and assets**
👨🏻 💻

* Handle first-level support tickets on your own, from diagnosis to resolution.
* Configure and set up laptops, workstations and peripherals (hardware and software).
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and manage repairs with vendors.
* Keep the IT asset inventory accurate and up to date.

**Systems and infrastructure**
🖥️

* Create and provision virtual machines, and troubleshoot VM issues.
* Manage user onboarding and offboarding, including account and access setup, together with the HQ IT team.
* Carry out patching and OS updates for clients and VMs, following central guidelines.
* Manage and renew CAD/CAE software licenses on the India servers.
* Support backup and recovery activities with the HQ team.
* Manage local network configuration and connectivity, and work with the HQ team on network changes.

**Vendors and procurement**
📝

* Act as the local contact for hardware, software and internet service providers.
* Coordinate with vendors to resolve issues and escalate when needed.
* Manage AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) for hardware and software.
* Support hardware and software procurement in line with company processes.

**Ways of working**
📌

* Track activities and progress in our ticketing system (Jira).
* Write clear, concise documentation for the procedures you follow.
* Communicate proactively with users and with the HQ team, for example by notifying users before planned maintenance and escalating critical issues promptly.
* Follow IT security and data protection policies when handling systems and sensitive information.

**Must have**
✔️

* 2–3 years of experience in a system administration or IT support role.
* Strong skills in configuring and troubleshooting Windows client devices.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory: user accounts, groups and permissions.
* Basic Linux administration skills.
* Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms (e.g., Proxmox, VMware, Hyper-V).
* Good understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN and Wi-Fi.
* Experience with hardware troubleshooting and asset management.
* Experience working with vendors and service providers.
* Good written and spoken English, since you'll work daily with colleagues in Italy.

**Nice to have 🔧**

* Exposure to backup solutions, ideally Veeam / Proxmox Backup Server.
* Experience managing engineering software licenses (e.g., FlexLM / FlexNet license servers for CAD/CAE tools).
* Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira.
* A relevant certification (e.g., CompTIA, Microsoft, CCNA, VMware).

**Who you are**
👨🏻 💻

* Reliable and organised. You complete tasks accurately and on time.
* Calm under pressure, patient and empathetic with users who need help.
* Open to feedback and eager to learn from more experienced colleagues.
* Proactive: you ask questions, share what you learn and suggest small improvements.
* You understand that IT supports the business, and you prioritise with that in mind.

**Perks and benefits 💸🏠⏰**

* Flexible working-hours
* Remote working
* Travel opportunities: you will have the possibility to join our worldwide colleagues
* International experience
* Continuous growth and learning: you will constantly have access to internal soft skills and technical skills training, and also external events and industry conferences
* Friendly work environment
* Internal and external training
* Insurance
* Competitive salary

ESTECO is an independent software provider that connects optimization, simulation, and business processes to enable smarter design of products and services. Fueled by scientific research — its vendor-neutral, reliable technology serves over 400 organizations across automotive, aerospace, and manufacturing globally. * Strong incident and problem management experience, including technical triage, root cause analysis, corrective actions and production communications
* Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, high availability, capacity management, performance bottlenecks and failure modes

Desirable Skills

title: Senior SAP Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a senior
**SAP S/4HANA OTC Functional Consultant**
with minimum 6-8 years of core SAP OTC/SD experience to play a key role in our S/4HANA project. The candidate must have the experience of working on the transformational projects converting legacy application’s business processes into S4 application. He/she will be responsible for designing, configuring, and maintaining key Order-to-Cash processes, managing complex third-party and internal interfaces, and driving cross-functional integrations specifically with Procurement, SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) and broader Logistics Execution (LE). Experience of working for the interfaces using BTP or at least should be knowledgeable in that area.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Order-to-Cash Execution:**
  Design, configure, and optimize core OTC functional areas including Master Data (BP, Materials), Order Management, Deliveries and financial accounting.
* **Interface Management:**
  Design, build, and troubleshoot along with BTP team using BAPIs, REST/SOAP APIs connecting SAP OTC with legacy systems, external customer portals, and third-party logistics (3PL) providers. Should be able to handle interface issues between legacy system and latest version of S4 using BTP.
* **EWM & Logistics Integration:**
  Lead functional integration between SAP OTC, Sales & Distribution (SD), and SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM). Ensure seamless end-to-end data flow for delivery processing, picking, packing, goods issue, and wave management.
* **Logistics Execution (LE):**
  Manage end-to-end LE processes including Outbound Delivery Processing, Shipping and Stock Transport Orders (STOs).
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner closely with MM, EWM, FI, Basis and security teams to ensure complete functional alignment across cross-module integration points.
* **Delivery & Support:**
  Draft clear Functional Specifications (FSDs), execute integration/UAT testing, support cutover activities, and provide post-go-live hypercare.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:**
  6-8 years of dedicated hands-on functional experience in S4HANA OTC / SD.
* **EWM Integration Expertise:**
  Deep, demonstrated understanding of the OTC–EWM interface (e.g., Outbound Delivery Orders, Stock Transfers, Confirmation of Goods Issue).
* **Logistics Execution Mastery:**
  Comprehensive understanding of end-to-end LE processes, shipping workflows, and inventory movements linked to sales flows.
* **Interface Design:**
  Advanced skill set in mapping of interfaces using BTP, interface troubleshooting, error handling, and API integration.
* **Full Lifecycle Projects:**
  Experience completing at least 2–3 full lifecycle SAP implementations or major upgrade/conversion projects (SAP S/4HANA experience is a must).
* **Communication:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to manage business stakeholders and technical development teams.

title: SAP CCM
description:
Job Description: SAP CCM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Functional Lead / Senior Consultant**
with
**8 to 10 years**
of hands-on expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD)/enhancements. The ideal candidate will possess deep specialization in
**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

* Perform functional, regression, integration, and system testing activities
* Build and deploy AI-powered solutions using Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and Cloud technologies to support business automation and innovation

* Utilise automation tools such as Selenium, Postman, Playwright, and Cypress for test scripting and execution

* Ensure compliance with quality standards, testing processes, documentation requirements, and audit expectations
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality assurance effectiveness and delivery excellence

**Who You Are**

* 2 to 6 years of professional experience in software testing within a telecommunications environment
* ISTQB Foundation Certification (or equivalent)
* Strong understanding of the software testing lifecycle and quality assurance best practices
* Experience in manual testing with exposure to test automation frameworks and tools
* Familiarity with web, mobile, digital, and enterprise applications
* Working knowledge of JIRA, XRAY, SDM, Azure DevOps, or similar test management and defect tracking tools
* Knowledge of telecom business domains, including Salesforce, Design Automation, and Digital Ordering solutions
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail
* Effective communication, stakeholder engagement, and coordination skills
* Ability to independently manage multiple testing activities and priorities
* Commitment to quality, process adherence, and continuous improvement

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to work within a global telecommunications organisation supporting critical business applications
* Exposure to digital transformation programmes and next-generation testing practices
* Collaboration with diverse cross-functional teams across technology and business domains
* Opportunities to contribute to innovative AI and cloud-based solutions
* Professional development in both manual and automation testing disciplines
* Experience working across the full software development and testing lifecycle within a complex enterprise environment

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced testing methodologies across web, mobile, digital, and enterprise applications
* Practical experience with automation tools including Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, and Postman
* Telecom domain expertise covering digital ordering, Salesforce ecosystems, and design automation platforms
* Defect management, test governance, and quality assurance process optimisation

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.

title: Lead Generation Executive
description:
**Job Description – Business Development Executive (Lead Generation)**

**Location: Pune (Work From Office)**

**Experience Required:**
**3+ years**

**Target Markets:**
**USA and Europe**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Business Development Executive to own outbound lead generation for our international IT services business. The role is focused on identifying and engaging decision-makers through LinkedIn Sales Navigator and personalized manual email outreach, qualifying them, and booking discovery calls for our senior sales team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Lead Generation and Prospecting**

• Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo.io, based on our ideal customer profile (industry, company size, geography, and decision-maker titles such as CEO, Founder, CTO).

• Run daily LinkedIn outreach: connection requests, personalized messages, and follow-ups.

• Write and send personalized manual emails to decision-makers, based on research of their business.

• Verify and maintain accurate contact data.

• Track market trends and buying signals to prioritize target accounts.

• Keep improving messaging and targeting to increase reply rates.

**2. Lead Qualification and Meeting Scheduling**

• Engage prospects who respond and qualify them on budget, authority, need, and timeline.

• Follow up on warm leads and schedule discovery and introductory calls with the senior sales team.

• Prepare a short brief for each meeting before handover.

**3. CRM and Reporting**

• Update all leads, conversations, and follow-ups in the CRM and tracking sheets.

• Share daily and weekly reports with the Manager (outreach volume, replies, and meetings booked).

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

• 3+ years of experience in lead generation / outbound business development for an IT services company (mandatory).

• Strong hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

• Proven experience with personalized manual email outreach to international decision-makers.

• Experience working with US and/or European clients and markets.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to draft professional emails and lead introductory calls.

• Working knowledge of IT services (web, mobile, AI/GenAI, and software development).

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

• Willing to work from our Pune office.

**Preferred Skills**

• Experience with Apollo.io, email verification tools, and a CRM.

• Experience with cold calling.

• Master's degree in Marketing or a related discipline (good to have).

title: Market Performance Manager
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.
  
  
**What We Do...**
Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.
  
  
That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.
  
  
**About The Market Performance Manager Role…**
The Market Performance Team Manager leads a high-performing team of Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists who optimise distribution and revenue strategy for our hotel customers. This role is accountable for building and scaling a centre of excellence in market performance — ensuring hotels maximise bookings and profitable revenue through the intelligent use of SiteMinder’s platform, channel mix, and pricing strategies.
  
  
Combining strategic leadership, deep commercial acumen and strong people management, the Market Performance Team Manager oversees pipeline and performance across all optimisation initiatives, drives capability development in revenue and distribution management, and partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver measurable uplift in customer value, retention and revenue outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do…**

* Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement comprehensive market management strategies that maximise product value and drive customer ROI, with a strong focus on revenue and distribution optimisation.
* Team Development & Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists. Provide coaching, training and feedback to build deep revenue and distribution optimisation capability across the team.
* Pipeline Management: Own and manage the optimisation and revenue pipeline (initiatives, cases and opportunities), including forecasting, prioritisation and resourcing. Monitor pipeline health, conversion and velocity, and drive continuous improvements in team productivity.
* Performance Reporting: Build and maintain clear performance reporting on optimisation pipeline, revenue impact and team productivity, providing visibility to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, to customers.
* Distribution Optimisation: Design and oversee strategies that optimise distribution mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to drive profitable bookings for hotels. Ensure the team can diagnose channel performance issues and execute corrective actions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales to ensure market performance and optimisation needs inform product development and go-to-market strategies.
* Optimisation Program Design: Create and implement scalable optimisation programs that systematically improve customer outcomes and revenue performance across different tiers and segments.
* Performance Management: Consistently meet or exceed team KPIs. Monitor pipeline, revenue and productivity metrics, and coach Team Leads and Specialists to improve conversion, quality and impact.
* Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the business. Represent the market performance function in executive forums and champion customer and revenue outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance optimisation processes, tools and methodologies. Drive innovation in market performance and revenue optimisation delivery to maintain competitive advantage.

**What You Have…**

* Extensive experience in market management at an OTA, customer success, upgrade sales, account management, BPO or similar customer-facing roles, with good experience in a leadership position managing teams (Team Operations).
* Experience leading and developing managers (particularly Team Leads) and frontline specialists, including training and coaching on revenue and distribution optimisation best practices.
* Available to flex schedule across global hours
* Proven track record of designing and implementing successful market performance and/or optimisation programs that drive measurable revenue and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform strategic decision-making, manage a pipeline and demonstrate ROI (e.g. RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, channel mix, conversion, productivity).
* Solid grounding in hotel revenue management concepts, including demand forecasting, pricing, inventory and channel management, and competitive set analysis.
* Preferable experience optimising distribution strategy and channel mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to improve profitability and share.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at all levels of an organisation. Fluent English required; additional languages (Spanish, German, French, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, Bahasa, Portuguese or Mandarin) are a plus.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable market performance and revenue optimisation plans.
* Experience in the hotel industry or travel technology sector is highly desirable; background in Market Performance Management from an OTA is highly beneficial.
* Advanced negotiation skills with the ability to train teams in contract negotiation and value-based selling.
* Proficient in Salesforce and G-Suite with ability to analyse data across Salesforce reporting, Tableau (as a reader) and Google Sheets.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Mental health and well-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
  
  
When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Lead - Customer Quality
description:
Lead - Customer Quality Assurance

Location: Pune / Multiple Plant Locations

Experience: 10-12 Years

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering

Role Purpose

The Customer Quality Assurance (CQA) professional will lead technical investigations of customer complaints, warranty returns, and field failures across Electrical & Electronics product lines. The role will focus on identifying scientifically validated root causes, driving corrective and preventive actions, strengthening product and process robustness, and ensuring compliance with automotive quality standards while enhancing customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Complaint & Failure Analysis

* Lead detailed investigations of customer complaints involving mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, material, and system-level failures.
* Analyze customer rejection trends, warranty claims, and defect patterns using quality tools and statistical techniques.
* Correlate field failures with manufacturing, testing, and validation data to identify root causes.
* Perform Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) studies to validate conclusions.
* Prepare technical reports and support customer discussions for complaint closure.

Quality Standards & Compliance

* Ensure adherence to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, VDA, AIAG, and OEM-specific quality requirements.
* Support customer audits, internal audits, Layered Process Audits (LPA), and compliance reviews.
* Govern the deployment of APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, FMEA, Control Plans, and reliability standards.

Structured Problem Solving

* Drive root cause investigations using:
* 8D Methodology
* A3 Problem Solving
* PDCA
* 5 Why Analysis
* Fishbone Diagram
* Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
* Cause & Effect Matrix
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Validate corrective actions through testing, simulation, and evidence-based analysis.

Warranty & Reliability Engineering

* Conduct field failure and warranty analysis using:
* Weibull Analysis
* Failure Rate Modeling
* Reliability Growth Analysis
* Life Prediction & Degradation Modelling
* Identify recurring failure modes and reliability risks.
* Collaborate with R&D and Quality teams to address product and process vulnerabilities.

Preventive Quality Improvement

* Integrate customer complaint learnings into:
* DFMEA & PFMEA Updates
* Design Robustness Improvements
* DVP&R Enhancement
* Special Characteristic Identification
* Control Plan Optimization
* Error Proofing (Poka-Yoke) Initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement projects to reduce customer complaints and warranty failures.

Analytics & Reporting

* Develop dashboards and metrics for:
* Customer Complaints
* Warranty Trends
* Product-wise Failure Analysis
* Root Cause Distribution
* Corrective Action Effectiveness
* Provide predictive insights and early warnings on emerging quality concerns.

Cross Functional Collaboration

* Partner with R&D, NPD, Manufacturing Engineering, Plant Quality, Supplier Quality, and Component Development teams.
* Facilitate problem-solving workshops and coach teams on advanced quality methodologies.
* Drive standardization of complaint analysis processes across multiple manufacturing locations.

title: Water Domain Business Lead
description:
**Job Title**
: Water Domain Business Lead

**Location**
: India (Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad, Delhi)

**Job Summary**

The Water Domain Business Lead is responsible for building and growing strategic client relationships across the water and wastewater utilities sector. The role combines domain leadership, consultative business development, account planning, solution shaping, and ecosystem collaboration to create qualified demand and convert opportunities into sustainable revenue. The position acts as a trusted business advisor to clients, connects business priorities with TCS capabilities, and orchestrates cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, outcome-led propositions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Achieves Revenue & Pipeline Targets through Demand Creation**

* Identify and develop demand across water and wastewater utilities by connecting client priorities with relevant TCS capabilities, industry solutions, digital engineering, IoT, data, cloud, asset management, operational technology, and transformation services.
* Build and maintain a healthy, qualified opportunity pipeline through executive conversations, account workshops, industry insights, targeted campaigns, partner propositions, and proactive solution concepts.
* Lead opportunity origination and early-stage qualification, establish business value, define the buying context, and shape a clear path from client need to funded initiative.
* Work with sales, accounts, consulting, delivery, solution, and partner teams to improve conversion from lead to qualified opportunity and from opportunity to closure.
* Monitor the pipeline for value, probability, ageing, competitive position, decision milestones, and dependencies, and initiate timely recovery actions where required.

**2 Ownership of Targets**

* Own agreed revenue, order-book, pipeline, and demand-generation targets for the water domain, with clear accountability for performance and forecast accuracy.
* Translate annual business objectives into account-level and solution-level pursuits, measurable milestones, and disciplined execution plans.
* Maintain visibility of target attainment, risks, gaps, and corrective actions, and provide evidence-based updates to leadership.
* Balance short-term pursuit conversion with medium-term pipeline development and long-term strategic account growth.

**3 Positions TCS as Business Advisor**

* Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business strategy, operational challenges, regulatory context, investment priorities, technology landscape, and transformation agenda.
* Engage client executives and business leaders with a point of view on sector trends, operational resilience, customer and environmental outcomes, asset performance, data-led decision-making, and digital transformation.
* Create client-specific value propositions, business cases, roadmaps, maturity assessments, and executive narratives that clearly link TCS capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
* Bring relevant TCS experience, reusable assets, alliances, and cross-industry innovation into client discussions without presenting generic or technology-led propositions.
* Build credibility through domain depth, commercial awareness, structured problem solving, and consistent follow-through.

**4 Alliance Led Growth**

* Define and execute alliance-led growth strategies for the water domain by aligning TCS capabilities with complementary technology, engineering, platform, and industry-partner offerings.
* Identify priority alliance partners and jointly develop differentiated propositions, market plays, account-entry strategies, and repeatable solution patterns for water and wastewater utilities.
* Create joint go-to-market plans covering target clients, demand-generation campaigns, executive engagement, workshops, demonstrations, thought leadership, and industry events.
* Work with alliance, sales, consulting, solution, and delivery teams to originate and qualify partner-influenced opportunities and establish clear ownership across the pursuit lifecycle.
* Develop joint value propositions and business cases that define the client outcome, combined capabilities, delivery responsibilities, commercial model, and competitive differentiation.
* Maintain governance for alliance pursuits, including opportunity tracking, pipeline contribution, partner commitments, solution dependencies, risks, and agreed next actions.
* Strengthen partner relationships through regular business reviews, shared account planning, solution enablement, credential development, and structured knowledge exchange.

**5 Collaboration & Networking**

* Create effective virtual teams across sales, account management, consulting, delivery, engineering, industry units, centers of excellence, alliances, and marketing.
* Build a strong internal network to mobilize the right subject-matter experts, credentials, accelerators, and leadership sponsorship for each opportunity.
* Develop relationships with technology and industry partners to shape complementary propositions and strengthen market access.
* Encourage knowledge sharing across geographies and accounts, including reuse of proven case studies, solution patterns, lessons learned, and proposal content.
* Represent the water domain in relevant client forums, internal communities, industry events, and partner engagements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, environmental sciences, business, or a related discipline.

A postgraduate qualification in business, management, utilities, or a related field is desirable.

**Experience**

* 10+ experience in the water and wastewater utilities sector, with a strong understanding of utility business, operational, asset, customer, environmental, and regulatory priorities.
* Proven experience in business development, consulting, client relationship management, account growth, solution shaping, or strategic sales in a complex B2B environment with $20M+ target achievement.
* Demonstrated ability to originate and qualify opportunities, influence senior stakeholders, coordinate multi-disciplinary teams, and support complex pursuits through closure.
* Experience developing client-specific propositions, business cases, account plans, executive presentations, and proposal responses.
* Experience working across geographies and with distributed teams, alliance partners, and delivery organizations is desirable.

**Technical Skills**

* Water and wastewater utility domain knowledge, including core business processes and the operating context of asset-intensive utilities.
* Working knowledge of digital utility capabilities such as operational technology and IT convergence, SCADA and telemetry, IoT, data platforms, analytics and AI, GIS, asset management, digital twins, cloud, and cyber security.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, value drivers, implementation roadmaps, and differentiated propositions.
* Strong capability in opportunity qualification, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, commercial awareness, and proposal governance.
* Proficiency in creating executive-ready presentations, structured documents, business cases, and management reports.
* Soft Skills
* Executive presence and the ability to communicate credibly with business, operational, and technology stakeholders.
* Consultative listening, structured problem solving, commercial judgement, and a strong client-outcome orientation.
* Influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to align stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Collaboration, cultural awareness, adaptability, resilience, and disciplined follow-through.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and attention to detail.

**Measures of Success**

* Achievement of agreed revenue, order-book, qualified-pipeline, and demand-creation outcomes.
* Quality, coverage, progression, and forecast accuracy of the water-domain opportunity pipeline.
* Growth in strategic client relationships, executive access, and TCS participation in priority transformation initiatives.
* Conversion of differentiated propositions into qualified pursuits and successful outcomes.
* Effectiveness of cross-functional collaboration, governance adherence, and leadership reporting.
* Contribution to reusable water-domain assets, thought leadership, partner propositions, and team capability.

title: Vendor Reconciliation and Open Items Specialist - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a finance operations professional to manage vendor reconciliations and open vendor line items in Pune. In this full-time role, you will reconcile vendor statements against SAP ledgers, investigate discrepancies, drive the closure of aged balances and support accurate month-end reporting. You will collaborate with vendors and internal teams to maintain accurate accounts, timely closures and effective financial controls.
  
  
This opportunity is suited to candidates with 2 to 6 years of experience in vendor reconciliation, accounts payable, finance operations or shared services who enjoy analysing financial information, resolving discrepancies and working collaboratively with stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Vendor reconciliation**

* Reconcile vendor statements of account with SAP system ledgers
* Investigate and resolve missing invoices, incorrect postings, duplicate transactions and pricing or quantity mismatches
* Prepare clear reconciliation summaries and ageing reports
* Provide vendors and internal stakeholders with progress updates, findings and recommended actions

**Open line item management**

* Review open vendor line items and coordinate their timely resolution
* Conduct ageing analyses across 30, 60, 90 and 180-plus-day categories
* Prioritise the clearance of aged balances in accordance with established processes
* Follow up with vendors and internal teams, maintaining accurate action trackers
* Escalate long-pending items through the appropriate channels

**Stakeholder and vendor coordination**

* Respond professionally to vendor queries through email and calls
* Collaborate with Accounts Payable, Procurement and business teams to resolve issues
* Maintain complete supporting documentation and communicate actions transparently

**Systems, reporting and controls**

* Use SAP Accounts and Commercial modules to review and reconcile financial information
* Use Microsoft Excel to prepare reconciliations, trackers and reports
* Support month-end closure and audit activities by providing relevant data and clear explanations
* Contribute to accurate accounting records and effective financial controls

**Who You Are**

* You have 2 to 6 years of relevant experience in vendor reconciliation, accounts payable, finance operations or a shared services environment
* You have practical experience in vendor reconciliation and open line item management
* You understand fundamental accounting principles
* You can analyse financial data, identify discrepancies and support effective resolution
* You can communicate professionally with vendors and collaborate effectively across Accounts Payable, Procurement and business teams
* You can use SAP and Microsoft Excel for reconciliations, tracking and reporting
* You hold a bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or Business Administration
* An M.Com or MBA in Finance is advantageous but not essential

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* An opportunity to build specialist experience in purchase-to-pay operations, vendor reconciliation and open item management
* Exposure to SAP-based finance operations and structured reconciliation processes
* Experience collaborating with vendors and cross-functional teams, including Accounts Payable, Procurement and business stakeholders
* The opportunity to contribute to accurate financial records, timely month-end closure and audit readiness
* Practical involvement in resolving complex discrepancies and improving financial control outcomes

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced vendor statement and ledger reconciliation techniques
* Root-cause analysis for invoice, posting, duplication, pricing and quantity discrepancies
* Ageing analysis and prioritisation of open financial items
* SAP-based accounts and commercial transaction analysis
* Excel-based reconciliation, action tracking and operational reporting
* Month-end closure and audit support practices
* Vendor communication, stakeholder coordination and structured escalation
* Purchase-to-pay process knowledge and financial control awareness

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. We are a leading technology firm that integrates strategy, design, and software engineering to enable enterprises and technology disruptors across the globe to thrive as modern digital businesses. * **Backup & Recovery:**
  Monitor data backup systems and assist in maintaining data recovery procedures.
* **Vendor & Documentation Management:**
  Coordinate with vendors for procurement, repairs, warranties, and technical support. Maintain IT documentation, software licenses, audit reports, and system configurations.
* **Meeting & Collaboration Support:**
  Maintain video conferencing systems and other workplace collaboration tools.

* Minimum 6 months to 2 years of experience in IT support, system administration, or a similar role.

* Strong understanding of computer hardware, software installation, IT asset management, and laptop troubleshooting.
* Good problem-solving, documentation, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Laptop/desktop installation, maintenance, upgrades, and repair.
* ITIL knowledge or certifications such as CompTIA, Cisco, or Microsoft.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity practices and IT asset management tools.

title: Sr. Demo Engineer
description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a
**Senior Demo Engineer**
to join our global Demo Engineering team, serving as the lead escalation point for technical operations and demo environment tickets within the EMEA region. In this role, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and availability of demo environments used daily by Sales Engineers and field teams.

You will bring strong SaaS technical support experience alongside solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure, specifically
**AWS EC2**
and
**AWS Systems Manager (SSM)**
. You will be responsible for diagnosing complex issues, streamlining ticket escalations, maintaining system health, and enhancing demo platform automation.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Regional Escalation & Technical Support

* Serve as the primary senior technical contact and escalation point for all EMEA demo environment issues and support tickets.
* Perform deep technical triage, root-cause analysis, and rapid remediation for environment failures, configuration drift, and service interruptions.
* Partner closely with regional Sales Engineers (SEs) to provide timely ticket updates, operational guidance, and resolution SLAs.

Cloud Infrastructure & Systems Operations

* Manage, configure, and maintain virtual server infrastructure hosting demo environments primarily built on
  **AWS EC2**
  .
* Use
  **AWS Systems Manager (SSM)**
  for patch management, remote execution, parameter storage, and system maintenance across regional fleet instances.
* Monitor service health, application availability, and performance metrics to proactively prevent environment downtime.

SaaS Environment Maintenance & Quality Assurance

* Oversee SaaS tenant configurations, API integration points, and identity provider setups required for live SE demonstrations.
* Maintain consistency and baseline stability across regional tenant environments.

Automation & Process Improvement

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support tasks, environment provisioning, and health checks.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts and orchestration playbooks to improve platform stability and setup efficiency.

Qualifications & Requirements
  
  

* **Experience:**
  5+ years of technical support, systems engineering, or demo engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise software environments.
* **AWS Core Knowledge:**
  Deep working experience with
  **AWS EC2**
  instance management, networking basics (VPCs, Security Groups), and AMI maintenance.
* **Systems Administration:**
  Strong expertise in
  **AWS Systems Manager (SSM)**
  for fleet management, maintenance windows, and automation runbooks.
* **SaaS Support Mastery:**
  Proven track record in Tier 2/3 technical support, troubleshooting web applications, APIs, authentication mechanisms, and browser/client-side integrations.
* **Problem-Solving & Escalation Ownership:**
  Ability to independently manage high-priority technical escalations under tight deadlines while maintaining clear communication.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent verbal and written English communication skills to support cross-functional stakeholders across the EMEA region.

Preferred / Bonus Skills
  
  

* **Multi-Cloud Agent Platform Management:**
  Experience building, deploying, or managing AI agents using platform-native services such as
  **Amazon Bedrock Agents**
  ,
  **Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Builder**
  (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform), and
  **Azure AI Foundry**
  /
  **Microsoft Copilot Studio**
  .
* **Test & Task Automation:**
  Hands-on experience with end-to-end browser automation tools (e.g.,
  **Playwright**
  , Selenium, or Cypress).
* **Configuration Management:**
  Experience with infrastructure-as-code or automation frameworks such as
  **Ansible**
  ,
  **Chef**
  , Puppet, or Terraform.
* **Scripting:**
  Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for operational automation.
* **Domain Experience:**
  Knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), IAM, or enterprise security architectures.

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days
  
  

* **First 30 Days:**
  Complete onboarding on the Demo Engineering architecture, gain access to core AWS environments, and shadow regional ticket workflows.
* **First 60 Days:**
  Take primary ownership of EMEA escalation tickets, managing triage through resolution while maintaining baseline SLA targets.
* **First 90 Days:**
  Identify key friction points in EMEA environment reliability and deliver at least one automation or tooling improvement.

support product areas

title: SitecoreAI Content and Personalization Specialist
description:
**Position Overview**
Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced SitecoreAI Content and Personalization Specialist to join our Global Marketing IT team. This role will be responsible for driving enterprise content operations, digital asset management, AI-powered content optimization, personalization, and experimentation across the global Sitecore ecosystem.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Sitecore Content Hub, Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, and Sitecore Personalize, with proven experience designing and executing content strategies that enable scalable omnichannel experiences. This individual will partner with business, marketing, analytics, and technology teams to ensure content is structured, governed, optimized, and activated effectively across customer journeys.
  
  
A key objective of this role is to leverage Sitecore AI and Content Hub capabilities to improve content discoverability, automate content operations, enhance personalization, accelerate content production, and drive measurable business outcomes through testing and optimization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Sitecore AI Enablement**

* Leverage Sitecore AI capabilities to improve content creation, optimization, classification, tagging, and asset enrichment.
* Define and implement AI-assisted content workflows that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Utilize AI-driven insights to identify content gaps, optimization opportunities, and personalization strategies.
* Support AI-powered content recommendations and customer experience optimization initiatives.
* Collaborate with marketing teams to operationalize AI-enhanced content generation while ensuring governance and brand compliance.
* Evaluate and implement emerging Sitecore AI capabilities and best practices across the enterprise.

**Sitecore Content Hub Leadership**

* Serve as the subject matter expert for Sitecore Content Hub DAM, CMP, and Content Operations capabilities.
* Design and manage enterprise content taxonomies, metadata models, content schemas, and governance frameworks.
* Establish and maintain content lifecycle processes including creation, review, approval, publication, archival, and compliance.
* Drive adoption of Content Hub as the central source of truth for digital assets and marketing content.
* Configure and optimize Content Hub workflows, governance policies, permissions, and content approval processes.
* Lead metadata standardization, asset classification, tagging, and content discoverability initiatives.
* Support Content Hub integrations with XM Cloud, personalization platforms, analytics solutions, and downstream marketing channels.
* Drive content reuse and content modularization strategies to support omnichannel delivery and composable architecture.

**Personalization & Customer Experience Optimization**

* Design, implement, and optimize content experiences using Sitecore Personalize.
* Define personalization strategies based on audience segments, behavioral data, customer journeys, and engagement metrics.
* Partner with analytics teams to create audience targeting rules and content decisioning frameworks.
* Enable dynamic content delivery based on customer preferences, geography, product interests, lifecycle stage, and behavioral signals.
* Develop and maintain personalization governance and measurement frameworks.
* Monitor personalized experiences and continuously optimize outcomes based on data-driven insights.

**A/B Testing & Experimentation**

* Lead digital experimentation strategies across web experiences and customer journeys.
* Design and execute A/B tests, multivariate tests, content experiments, and personalization experiments using Sitecore capabilities.
* Define hypotheses, success metrics, statistical requirements, and reporting methodologies.
* Analyze experiment results and provide actionable recommendations to improve engagement, conversions, and customer experience.
* Establish best practices for testing, optimization, and experimentation governance.
* Collaborate with UX, Digital Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams to prioritize and execute testing roadmaps.

**Content Strategy & Governance**

* Define enterprise content architecture and reusable content models supporting XM Cloud and composable DXP initiatives.
* Establish best practices for content structure, SEO, accessibility, localization, and omnichannel publishing.
* Drive content quality assessment and optimization initiatives.
* Ensure alignment between content strategy, customer journeys, personalization objectives, and business goals.
* Maintain governance standards for metadata, taxonomy, tagging, content ownership, and lifecycle management.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must-Have Experience**

* 4 to 6 years of hands-on Sitecore experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Sitecore Content Hub (DAM/CMP) administration, implementation, or content operations.
* Strong experience with Sitecore AI capabilities and AI-driven content optimization.
* Hands-on experience with Sitecore Personalize.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing A/B testing and experimentation programs.
* Strong understanding of customer journey mapping, audience segmentation, and content personalization.
* Experience creating and managing enterprise taxonomies, metadata structures, and content governance frameworks.
* Experience with content modeling and reusable content design in Sitecore XM Cloud.
* Deep understanding of composable architecture and omnichannel content delivery.
* Experience working closely with marketing, content authors, product teams, UX teams, and analytics teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline
* Experience with Sitecore Search and content discovery capabilities.
* Experience with CDP, customer data platforms, and audience activation use cases.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted content operations and content supply chain initiatives.
* Knowledge of digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with SEO, accessibility, localization, and global content management practices.

**Top Mandatory Skills (Screening Criteria)**

* Sitecore Content Hub (DAM + CMP)
* Sitecore AI & Personalize
* Content Personalization Strategy
* A/B Testing & Experimentation
* Content Taxonomy & Metadata Management
* Content Governance

title: GTM Lead Generation Executive - US Hotels
description:
**Experience - 1-2 Years**

**Work Mode - In-Office (4PM - 2AM)**

**About Atica:**
Atica is a tech-led remote sales and revenue-management partner for hotels across the US, and the outsourced sales and revenue engine for 200+ independent US hotels. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and backed by leading investors (Titan Capital, DIBS). We are building our outbound function from the ground up, and this is one of its founding hires.

**The role:**
We are hiring the person who will build and run the engine that finds and qualifies the right accounts for our outbound team. This is a hands-on role that combines lead research and sourcing with automation: you will turn messy inputs — a company staying at our hotels, a market signal, an OTA-masked booking — into the one right decision-maker with a verified contact, and build the enrichment and signal pipelines (Clay, AI, data sources) that do this reliably at scale. In the early months, before the system is fully built, you will also do this resolution by hand. If you combine strong research judgment with an instinct for automation, this is a rare build-from-zero seat.

**Responsibilities**

* Resolve messy inputs to the one right decision-maker (travel, procurement, or operations) with a verified email and phone.
* Build and own the sourcing and enrichment engine: Clay tables, enrichment waterfalls, data pipelines, AI-assisted research.
* Turn guest data, market reports, and project alerts into high-intent, callable accounts.
* Deliver clean, verified, signal-rich lists into Salesforce, and measure and improve list quality and conversion.
* Automate repetitive work; if a task is done twice, it should become a workflow.

**Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with sourcing and enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, Seamless, or similar).
* Strong judgment resolving an ambiguous company to the right person, with clear reasoning not a spray of titles.
* A genuine appetite for automation and AI. A formal technical or engineering background is not required.
* Comfort being hands-on with research early, while building the system that scales it.
* Data discipline: verified records, clean handoffs, no guesswork.

**Please note before applying**

* Location: Yerwada, Pune (work from office). Shift: US hours, approximately 4 PM to 2 AM IST.
* This is a build-and-do role, especially in the first months — you will both build the system and do the hands-on account resolution. If you only want to architect systems without doing the research yourself, this is not the seat.

title: Co-Founder
description:
**About Refactyl**

Refactyl is building a safer way to modernise software codebases.

We help developers migrate legacy code to modern frameworks and languages through deterministic transformation rules, AI-assisted changes, real compiler verification and reviewable diffs.

Our vision is to make code modernisation something developers can run, verify and review rather than a risky, manual rewrite.

Explore the product: https://www.refactyl.com

**Why this opportunity exists**

I'm Yash Sharma, the technical founder of Refactyl.

I've been building the product and working on the engineering behind it.

Now I want to find the right person to help turn Refactyl into a real, growing business.

I'm not looking for someone to execute marketing tasks.

I’m looking for an experienced co-founder who can handle marketing, sales, finding customers and growing the business to turn our product into a successful business with real users and paying customers.

**I want us to build the company together.**

**What you'll be responsible for**

* Finding our first users and paying customers.
* Identifying developers, engineering teams and businesses that need code modernisation.
* Conducting customer discovery and understanding why people would or wouldn't use Refactyl.
* Building an acquisition strategy through direct outreach, developer communities, partnerships, technical content, SEO, and other experiments.
* Turning product demonstrations and trials into active users and customers.
* Developing our positioning, messaging, and sales process.
* Measuring what works, learning from rejection, and continuously improving our approach.
* Helping shape the business strategy and long-term direction of Refactyl.

You'll have meaningful ownership over how we take this product to market.

**Who I want to meet**

**I'm looking for someone with real-world experience who has demonstrated the ability to turn a product or business into something people actually use and pay for.**

**This is not an entry-level marketing opportunity or a role for someone looking to learn sales from scratch.**

**I'm looking for a potential co-founder who can bring meaningful experience, independent thinking, and execution to the business.**

**You could be a strong fit if you have:**

* **Demonstrable growth or sales experience:**
  You've acquired customers, generated revenue, built a sales pipeline, grown a product's user base, or helped an early-stage business gain traction.
* **Startup experience:**
  You've worked at an early-stage startup, built your own business or taken a product from an idea to real customers.
* **B2B or SaaS experience:**
  You understand how to identify potential customers, conduct discovery calls, communicate value, and convert interest into adoption or revenue.
* **A track record of execution:**
  You can explain what you personally accomplished, the strategies you used, and the results you achieved.
* **Independent ownership:**
  You can identify opportunities, formulate a plan, execute it and learn from the results without needing constant direction.

Experience with developer tools, technical products, developer communities or selling to engineering teams would be a significant advantage.

You don't necessarily need experience at a famous company or a particular number of years in the industry. What matters is relevant experience, evidence of results, and the ability to apply that experience to an early-stage product.

**Please don't apply solely because you are interested in startups or want to learn marketing.**

I'm looking for someone who can contribute meaningful expertise from the beginning.

**How to apply**

**Please include the following in your application:**

1. **Your background:**
   A brief overview of your relevant professional experience, previous startups or businesses you've built.
2. **Your results:**
   One or two examples of products or businesses you've helped grow, customers you've acquired, revenue you've generated, or sales outcomes you've achieved. Include numbers and timeframes where possible, and clearly explain your personal contribution.
3. **Your approach:**
   How would you identify and acquire Refactyl's first 10 users and first paying customer?
4. **Your availability:**
   How much time can you realistically commit to building Refactyl?
5. **Your motivation:**
   Why do you want to join Refactyl as a co-founder, and what would you bring to the founding team?

Please include your LinkedIn profile and any relevant portfolio, case studies, startup projects, or other evidence of your work.

Applications that only express enthusiasm without demonstrating relevant experience or execution will not be prioritised.

**What I am offering**

* The opportunity to help shape an early-stage software company from the ground up.
* A technical founder focused on building and improving the product.
* Real ownership over growth and go-to-market decisions.
* An equity-based founding partnership, with the structure negotiated transparently.
* The opportunity to build something ambitious together.

**Important transparency**

Refactyl is currently at an early stage and is pre-revenue.

There is no guaranteed salary or upfront cash compensation at this time.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a salaried position.

Equity, vesting, responsibilities, commitment and decision-making will be discussed openly before we agree to work together.

I'm looking for someone who understands the risks and genuinely wants to build a business together, not someone being promised quick money or guaranteed success.

I'm looking for a person with initiative, conviction, and the ability to turn ideas into action.

If you're interested in building Refactyl with me, I'd love to hear from you.

Pune, India

Within

**Collaboration & escalation**

* Partner with Identity, Network, Security and Endpoint teams to resolve cross-domain issues (Conditional Access impact triage, DNS/routing/proxy, device policy).
* Escalate to L3 with complete evidence (timeline, impact, logs, KQL outputs, reproduction steps, interim mitigations).

* Infrastructure Workplace (L3 engineering, service owners)
* Identity & Access Management (hybrid/Entra ID-only)

* Nerdio knowledge (nice to have).
* PowerShell for diagnostics and repetitive tasks.
* Teams optimization and performance troubleshooting exposure.

**Behaviors (Syensqo-aligned)**

* Compliance-first and risk-aware (follows change controls; protects data).
* Evidence-based problem solving (“scientific explorer” mindset).
* Customer-centric communication and strong operational discipline.
* Collaborative, proactive, and improvement-oriented.

**About Us**

* Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Inspired by the scientific councils which Ernest Solvay initiated in 1911, we bring great minds together to push the limits of science and innovation for the benefit of our customers, with a diverse, global team of more than 13,000 associates. Our solutions contribute to safer, cleaner, and more sustainable products found in homes, food and consumer goods, planes, cars, batteries, smart devices and health care applications. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity.

**Experience Required**

* Strong SQL capability with proficiency in analyzing complex datasets and workflow behavior.

**Beneficial but not essential.**

* Understanding of financial platforms or investment workflows.

L2 Cloud Operations Engineer – Role Description
  
  
Two shifts - Sun to Wed 06:30 am to 06:30 pm with Sun alternate
  
  
Thurs to Sun 06:30 am to 06:30 pm with Sun alternate

This role combines expertise in cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, automation, CI/CD troubleshooting, observability, security operations, and AIOps-driven incident management.
  
  
You will be responsible for ensuring complex incident resolution, platform reliability, DevOps enablement, Kubernetes operations, automation, and operational excellence across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.

* Lead complex incident triage, deep troubleshooting, and resolution across cloud and container platforms.
* Implement SRE best practices such as SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, and resilience engineering.

* Diagnose and resolve pipeline failures related to infrastructure, container builds, artifact storage, security scanning, and deployment orchestration.
* Enable self-service pipelines, progressive delivery, canary deployments, and rollback automation.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve deployment velocity, quality, and reliability.

* Cluster management
* Node scaling
* Networking troubleshooting
* Pod failures
* Storage & ingress debugging
* Manage cloud networking, compute, storage, IAM, load balancing, and security services.
* Observability, AIOps & Intelligent Operations

* Implement AIOps-driven alert correlation, noise reduction, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics.
* Build automated remediation workflows and self-healing systems.
* Drive MTTR reduction through automation-first operations.
* Security Operations & DevSecOps

* Implement DevSecOps automation for vulnerability scanning, compliance checks, and policy enforcement.
* Support cloud security posture management (CSPM), IAM governance, secrets management, and certificate lifecycle management.
* Automation, Infrastructure as Code & Engineering Excellence
* Build and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, and Bicep.
* Develop automation scripts and tools using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Go.
* Implement event-driven automation and auto-healing frameworks.
* ITSM, Incident, Change & Problem Management
* Serve as the technical escalation point for L1 teams.
* Lead incident management, problem management, and change governance using ITIL best practices.
* Maintain high-quality SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* AWS DevOps Engineer – Professional / SysOps Administrator – Associate

* Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK
* Event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics
* AIOps platforms & auto-remediation frameworks

* IAM, secrets management, PKI & certificates

* Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go (any two)
