title: Application Support Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description: Role OverviewThe L2 Application Support Engineer (Technical Support Analyst) is a critical role within the Production Support and Operations team. This individual is responsible for providing high-quality technical support, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for complex enterprise applications and platforms. Acting as the bridge between L1 Helpdesk/Monitoring teams and L3 Development/Engineering groups, the L2 Engineer ensures system availability, stability, and adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in a fast-paced, enterprise technology environment.Key Responsibilities Incident & Problem ManagementEscalation Handling: Acknowledge and own incidents escalated by the L1 support team or monitoring alerts.Troubleshooting & Diagnosis: Perform in-depth technical analysis and root cause investigation of application, database, middleware, and infrastructure failures.Workaround Implementation: Apply approved temporary workarounds or permanent hotfixes to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.Collaboration: Partner with L3 developers, database administrators (DBAs), network engineers, and system administrators to resolve complex, multi-tiered issues.Incident Lifecycle Management: Track and document all incident progression within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) from creation through to resolution. Monitoring, Observability & Preventive MaintenanceSystem Monitoring: Actively monitor application health, batch jobs, integration feeds, and system performance using enterprise observability suites.Proactive Interventions: Identify recurring patterns, error trends, or capacity bottlenecks and initiate preventative actions.Health Checks: Perform daily health checks, start-of-day (SOD) and end-of-day (EOD) verifications, and batch processing runs. Release, Deployment & Configuration ManagementDeployment Validation: Support the verification of application deployments, system patches, and infrastructure upgrades during maintenance windows.Configuration Controls: Maintain and update application configuration files, environment variables, and parameter settings under strict change management processes.Environment Management: Assist in maintaining non-production (UAT/Staging) and production environments to ensure consistency. Communication & Stakeholder ManagementStatus Updates: Provide clear, timely, and precise communications to business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leadership during critical (Sev-1/Sev-2) incidents.Bridges & War Rooms: Participate in or lead technical incident bridges to coordinate restoration efforts.Post-Incident Reviews: Contribute technical inputs to Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation. Documentation & Knowledge ManagementRunbooks & SOPs: Document and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), application architecture maps, and troubleshooting runbooks.Knowledge Sharing: Train L1 teams on common issue resolution paths to shift-left workloads and improve first-contact resolution rates.Qualifications & ExperienceEducation: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.Experience: 8+ years of experience in an application support, technical support, or systems engineering role (preferably in an enterprise or financial services environment).Certifications (Desirable):ITIL v3 or v4 Foundation certification.Professional certifications in AWS/Azure, Kubernetes (CKAD), Linux Administration, or Oracle/SQL.Required Technical SkillsDomainTechnology / ToolingOperating SystemsStrong hands-on experience with Linux/Unix environments (navigating file systems, checking logs, monitoring CPU/memory, cron jobs) and Windows Server.Scripting & AutomationProficiency in writing and debugging Shell scripting (Bash), PowerShell, or Python to automate daily tasks and analyze log files.Databases & QueryingStrong SQL skills (Oracle, MS SQL, Sybase, or PostgreSQL). Ability to write complex select queries, joins, analyze execution plans, and run database scripts.Middleware & Web ServersWorking knowledge of Apache, Tomcat, Nginx, WebSphere, and messaging queues like IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, or Apache Kafka.Cloud & ContainerizationFamiliarity with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure) concepts and container deployments.Monitoring & LoggingHands-on experience with tools such as Splunk, ELK Stack, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Grafana, or ITRS Geneos.ITSM & CollaborationExperience with ticketing tools like ServiceNow or Jira, and version control systems like Git or Bitbucket.Required Professional & Soft SkillsAnalytical Mindset: Excellent logical reasoning and problem-solving skills; ability to systematically break down a complex issue.Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical details into plain language for business teams.Pressure Tolerance: Calm demeanor under pressure, especially during high-severity system outages.Team Collaboration: Ability to work cohesively in a global, distributed cross-functional environment.------------------------------------------------------Job Family Group: Technology------------------------------------------------------Job Family:Applications Support------------------------------------------------------Time Type:Full time------------------------------------------------------Most Relevant SkillsPlease see the requirements listed above.------------------------------------------------------Other Relevant SkillsFor complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.------------------------------------------------------Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

title: OSS Support Engineer (Telecom Networks & Monitoring Applications) -Pune VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a skilled OSS Support Engineer to join the Digital Networks & OSS team and support the operation, maintenance, optimisation and continuous evolution of telecommunications OSS solutions. This role focuses on monitoring and assurance platforms including Ciena, Infinera, Chronos, Infoblox Grid Master and Clavister InControl, supporting enterprise customers and Vodafone local markets. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring high availability, performance and reliability of critical network monitoring applications while contributing to an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage OSS applications, including configuration, implementation, change management, rollouts and operational support for all assigned services, including participation in on-call activities
* Perform health checks, monitoring and troubleshooting activities to maintain hardware and software platforms in an optimal operational state
* Resolve incidents, problems and service requests, including implementing workarounds, changes and corrective actions
* Produce timely major incident reports and actively drive preventive and corrective measures following service-impacting events
* Support system integrators in the deployment of hardware, connectivity solutions, EMS and NMS platforms across primary and secondary data centres
* Execute and coordinate BAU patching, upgrades and hotfix deployments in line with change management processes
* Modify and adapt existing software solutions where required to improve system performance, stability and customer experience
* Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to support service delivery and operational objectives
* Ensure technical deliveries are fit for purpose and aligned with operational requirements
* Contribute to proactive service assurance and continuous service improvement initiatives

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline
* Minimum 2 to 5 years of experience in IT, telecommunications OSS application support or network operations environments
* Experience supporting OSS platforms such as Ciena, Infinera, Chronos, Infoblox Grid Master and Clavister InControl
* Good knowledge of Unix shell scripting, SQL and Python
* Experience working with databases including Oracle SQL, Oracle Exadata and MySQL
* Understanding of network management and integration protocols such as SNMP, CORBA and SOAP/XML
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive operational mindset
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to collaborate across teams and manage stakeholder relationships
* Understanding of operational support processes, incident management and change management practices

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to support business-critical OSS platforms used across enterprise customers and Vodafone markets
* Exposure to complex telecommunications environments, network monitoring systems and service assurance operations
* Hands-on experience with industry-recognised technologies, operational processes and large-scale infrastructure
* Collaboration with global teams, stakeholders and technology partners
* Involvement in continuous improvement, optimisation and transformation initiatives within Digital Networks & OSS

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced OSS operations, monitoring and assurance practices
* Telecom network management and fault management processes
* Enterprise-scale incident, problem and change management methodologies
* Automation and scripting capabilities using Unix shell scripting, SQL and Python
* Experience with cloud platforms, integration technologies and network management protocols
* Technical delivery, stakeholder management and service optimisation skills in a global telecommunications environment

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Musketeer
description:
**Purpose of the Job**
The Musketeer represents Red Bull in their area, gaining the customers confidence, securing the availability and visibility of Red Bull at POS, and being responsible for the continuous volume growth. The Musketeers will constantly detect business opportunities and trends in their area, build a strong network of decision makers, possess strong negotiation skills, and foster a solution-oriented mindset.
  
  
**All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:**
**Major Activities to Ensure Achievement of key Results and Deliverables**
**“Living” the Red Bull On Premise culture**
Assume and live the Red Bull OP Culture. Creation of “kindred spirits” Seen as a credible and knowledgeable person to know in the On Premise. Demonstrates that they are seen as a “Do it now” person by influential contacts, brilliant knowledge and leverage of all brand properties. Live and breathe the nightlife environment. Engage key consumers through innovative activation that differentiates Red Bull from other drinks. Take responsibility for personal development and development as a Musketeer.
  
  
**Communication**
On premise Know-how and Red Bull culture transfer to our customers. Permanent teamwork with other Musketeers and communication with his Area Manager. Develop relative industry relationships (Dj`s, Promoters, Endemic Magazines, etc.) that results in business building initiatives.
  
  
**Event Activation**
Ensure availability and premium High 5 execution around 3rd party and Red Bull events. Negotiate and execute, pro-actively searching for opportunities to implement creative elements that drive Red Bull’s brand image and to offset money. Attendance on key 3rd party and Red Bull events. Organize incentives for customers under previous authorization of his superior. Searching the profitability of all invitations.
  
  
**Territory Management**
Grow & protect On Premise accounts in the related region. Permanent analysis of the territory and account specific business to find opportunities and to drive distribution. Correct positioning of the Red Bull brand and the Red Bull product portfolio in the territory. Identification, care and continuously development of local and regional On Premise accounts by a proper Route Planning. Set volume goals with each account that includes execution against Red Bull KPI’s. Review business volume and all business building initiatives permanently. Drive cooperation with the local Distributor’s Sales Force in order to reach an adequate numeric distribution. Routinely perform Staff Education/Energizers to ensure brand understanding, perfect serve, and encourage optimum pricing.
  
  
**Administration**
Permanent optimization of all OP Tools (OP Knowledge Base, Infonet, CRM, Warehouse, POS …). Negotiate and implement commercial partnership agreements. Offset funds from financial contribution to added value. Fulfilment of report deadlines. Management of the local On Premise Budget. Bottom-up planning and tracking of all marketing tools.
  
  
**Market research**
Observation and reports of competitor activities. Active search of new opportunities for the Business in the region. Identification of EPC outlets.
  
  
**On Premise Marketing**
Putting the On Premise marketing strategy into practice. Maintain and utilize tools appropriately (Point of sale materials) to drive vertical growth. Ensure that all marketing tools are staged in the right accounts according to international On Premise guidelines. Engage and differentiate the brand through innovative support following the On Premise vision of bringing added value to our customers.
  
  
**Key Priorities**
Securing the fulfilling of all International and national On Premise guidelines and the execution standards to reach a vertical growth in their customers. Continuously tracking of results accordingly. High 5 Execution Perfect Serve: Ensure a cold Red Bull can is given to consumer when ordered as part of a mixer or as a stand-alone beverage. Perfect Visibility: Stages perfect visibility in order to optimize sales. Consumption Activation: Sells in appropriate consumption activation tools and communication pieces. Right Price: Encourage the optimum price for Red Bull and Red Bull products in all managed accounts as per international guidelines. Menu placements: Ensures Red Bull products are listed as per international guidelines on each menu as a stand-alone beverage and as part of a long drink.
  
  
**Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:**

* Education and Qualifications Graduate in any stream.
* Experience
* Preferred: 1+ years experience in a sales position with a strong track record of success.
* Outstanding local market knowledge, contacts and experience in “the scene”.
* Profile, Knowledge and Skills
* Good communication skills, ability to manage and cultivate good relationships.
* Negotiation and Objection Handling skills. Has a basic understanding of commercial maths.
* Business and scene savvy, committed, passionate and able to live late night lifestyle.
* Must be proficient in EDV (Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.).

title: Senior Programmatic Integration Specialist (Fixed Term Contract)
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
*storytellers*
bringing our characters to life, the
*creators*
bringing them to your living rooms and the
*dreamers*
creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Programmatic Integration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in FreeWheel Ad Server and FreeWheel Marketplace, and strong knowledge of the wider programmatic advertising ecosystem. The role will own and support technical connectivity across the ad server, FreeWheel Marketplace, DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, and other advertising technology partners.

The role will work closely with Ad Sales, Product, Engineering, Trafficking, and external technology partners and vendors to diagnose complex issues, support new integrations, drive technical improvements, and establish best practices. The successful candidate will be a key technical SME for FreeWheel and Marketplace, combining strong hands-on expertise with the ability to lead technical discussions and guide the wider team.

**Note**
: This role is a fixed term contract position for a duration of 12 Months on WBD payroll itself.

**FreeWheel & Marketplace Expertise**

* Define and promote best practices for FreeWheel and Marketplace integrations, configurations, troubleshooting, and operational processes.
* Work directly with FreeWheel and external vendors on technical investigations, product capabilities, new integrations, and resolution of complex issues.
* Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis of FreeWheel Marketplace issues, including integration failures, deal delivery issues, discrepancies, configuration problems, and ad-serving behaviour.
* Understand Marketplace configuration, inventory and deal flows, auction/request-response behaviour, partner setup, and dependencies between FreeWheel and external platforms.
* Own and support end-to-end FreeWheel Marketplace connectivity with SSPs, DSPs, DSP-side demand, exchanges, and other programmatic partners.
* Act as the internal subject-matter expert for FreeWheel Ad Server and FreeWheel Marketplace, with a deep understanding of how the platforms support publisher monetization and programmatic workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**
Ad Tech Integration & Connectivity

* Own and support end-to-end integrations and connectivity between the ad server, DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, and other programmatic partners.
* Manage and support API, oRTB, VAST, and other technical integrations, ensuring robust data and ad-request/response flows across platforms.
* Lead technical assessment, testing, validation, and launch of new ad-tech integrations and partner connections.
* Ensure integrations are configured correctly and aligned with business, technical, and operational requirements.

Technical Troubleshooting & Support

* Act as the senior technical point of contact for complex ad-serving, programmatic, integration, and delivery issues.
* Troubleshoot issues across the end-to-end ad-tech stack, identifying root causes and driving resolution with internal teams and external partners.
* Support the wider Programmatic team with technical investigations, debugging, and resolution of platform or integration issues.
* Use tools such as Charles Proxy, Wireshark, browser developer tools, logs, XML/VAST inspection, and platform diagnostics to investigate issues.
* Analyze discrepancies, ad-request/response flows, delivery failures, VAST errors, oRTB issues, and other technical problems.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

* Work closely with Ad Sales partners to understand requirements, resolve technical issues, and ensure programmatic solutions support commercial objectives.
* Lead technical discussions with SSPs, DSPs, ad-tech vendors, and other external partners.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to internal stakeholders, translating complex technical issues into clear business implications and actions.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Trafficking, Operations, and other teams to resolve issues and deliver new capabilities.

Technical Leadership & Best Practices

* Establish and drive best practices for ad-server, DSP, SSP, and programmatic integrations.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, integration guides, troubleshooting playbooks, and operational standards.
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Share knowledge with the wider team and provide technical guidance and coaching on ad-tech integrations and troubleshooting.
* Stay current with developments in programmatic advertising, ad-server capabilities, oRTB standards, and emerging ad-tech solutions.

Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

* Monitor the health and performance of integrations and identify trends, recurring issues, and potential risks.
* Use data and technical analysis to identify opportunities for improving ad delivery, integration performance, and operational processes.
* Support the rollout of new markets, partners, products, and monetization capabilities from a technical integration perspective.

**Qualifications**
Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Advertising, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in ad tech or programmatic operations are a plus.

Experience

* 5+ years of experience in programmatic advertising, ad-tech integrations, ad operations, or a related technical role, with significant hands-on experience with FreeWheel Ad Server and FreeWheel Marketplace.
* Strong hands-on experience working across FreeWheel Ad Server, FreeWheel Marketplace, SSPs, DSPs, exchanges, and other programmatic platforms.
* Experience owning or supporting end-to-end integrations and troubleshooting complex ad-serving and programmatic issues.
* Strong understanding of oRTB, VAST/VPAID, APIs, XML, ad-request/response flows, and programmatic data flows.
* Hands-on experience with debugging tools such as Charles Proxy, Wireshark, browser developer tools, logs, or similar tools.
* Experience working directly with technology vendors and external programmatic partners on technical integrations and issue resolution.

Skills

* Strong technical problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Strong understanding of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, with deep knowledge of FreeWheel Ad Server, FreeWheel Marketplace, and end-to-end ad delivery.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and manage issues across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple technical issues, and drive problems through to resolution.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on continuous improvement, scalability, and operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in the streaming, CTV, OTT, or digital video advertising industry.
* Advanced FreeWheel expertise, including FreeWheel Marketplace; experience with other major ad-server platforms such as Google Ad Manager or Xandr is a plus.
* Experience working with CTV/OTT programmatic advertising and video ad delivery.
* Understanding of privacy frameworks and their impact on programmatic advertising and ad-tech integrations.

**Why This Role Matters**

This is a high-impact technical role at the centre of the programmatic advertising ecosystem. The Senior Programmatic Integration Specialist will help ensure reliable connectivity across the ad-tech stack, enable new commercial opportunities, resolve complex technical challenges, and establish scalable best practices for the wider team.

**How We Get Things Done…**

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at

















www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/

along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

**Championing Inclusion at WBD**

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
accessibility page
for instructions to submit your request.

title: Cyber DT&P - IAM Non Human Identity Specialist - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As an NHI Specialist, you will help organizations strengthen identity security for machines, services, applications, and AI agents across complex enterprise environments. In this role, you will design and implement controls for secrets, certificates, service accounts, and workload identities, applying the same governance and rigor used for human identities. The role combines privileged access management, cloud identity, and automation to reduce risk and improve resilience across modern platforms.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an NHI Specialist on the Cyber & Strategic Risk team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Establishing continuous discovery processes for non-human identities, including service accounts, application credentials, tokens, certificates, and secrets across cloud, on-premises, CI/CD, and software-as-a-service environments
* Designing and managing secrets management, certificate lifecycle, and workload identity solutions using platforms such as CyberArk Conjur, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Secrets Manager, and cloud-native identity capabilities
* Architecting and enforcing identity and privileged access controls for service accounts, applications, automation identities, and AI agents, including least-privilege access, just-in-time access, ephemeral credentials, and auditability
* Developing automation using PowerShell, Python, Terraform, and application programming interfaces (APIs) to support provisioning, credential rotation, compliance reporting, and platform integrations
* Conducting risk assessments, driving remediation of non-human identity findings, onboarding platforms into governance frameworks, and documenting standards, architecture, and runbooks in collaboration with security, platform, and application teams

**The team**
Cyber & Strategic Risk
  
  
The cyber risk services—IAM practice helps organizations in designing, developing, and implementing industry-leading IAM solutions to protect their information and confidential data, as well as help them build their businesses and supporting technologies to be more secure, vigilant, and resilient. The cyber risk services—IAM team delivers service to clients through following key areas of IAM:
  
  

* Application Onboarding
* Lifecycle Manager
* Compliance Manager
* Password Management
* Automated Provisioning
* Roles Management
* ITSM tools Integration
* Advanced Authentication Methods
* Strategy and Road Map

**Location: HYD/BLR/CHN/PUN**
**Shift Timings: General**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
* Experience with secrets management platforms, including CyberArk Conjur, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Secrets Manager, or comparable cloud-native solutions
* Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM), including roles, policies, entitlements, and least-privilege enforcement
* Experience implementing just-in-time access and ephemeral credential or session models
* Experience building non-human identity governance programs, including inventory, risk scoring, remediation, and credential lifecycle management
* Experience with public key infrastructure, certificate lifecycle management, and cloud IAM in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JSON Web Token (JWT)-based authentication, workload identity concepts, and automation using PowerShell, Python, APIs, or software development kits (SDKs)

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with non-human identity discovery tooling, including Token, Astrix, Oasis, or Clutch
* Experience securing AI agent or agentic workflows, including scoped credential issuance and runtime access control
* Experience with Kubernetes secrets, service mesh identity, or SPIFFE/SPIRE
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD pipeline security, or secret scanning tools
* Experience with non-human identity platforms or dashboards, including Entro, Astrix, Oasis, or Clutch

title: AVP – Partnerships & Operations (Founder’s Office)
description:
**About Robotex India**

Robotex India is a non-profit on a mission to make future skills (robotics, coding, AI, IoT and STEAM) accessible to every child from government schools and colleges
in India.

Founded in Pune in 2018, Robotex India brought one of the world’s largest robotics festival, Robotex International, to Indian classrooms. Our focus has been on children who rarely get this opportunity: students in government, rural and tribal schools/colleges, majorly first-generation learners.

**What we’ve built so far**

* **Scale:**
  1.5 million+ students reached across 15 states and 500+ schools
* **Teachers:**
  300,000 teachers training in progress on AI in pedagogy with Microsoft
* **Girls in STEM:**
  520,000+ girls brought into robotics, coding, STEM and AI
* **Robotex for Rural:**
  a CSR-funded programme, launched in 2019, that teaches coding, programming, AI and robotics to students from marginalised communities
* **Government partnerships:**
  we work directly with state governments and Zila Parishads so that programmes reach the most underserved communities
* **India’s first digital hackathon:**
  organised during the pandemic with FICCI FLO Pune and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, keeping learning alive when schools shut
* **National Championship:**
  the Robotex India National Championship is one of the country’s largest grassroots technology platforms. So far 250+ government school students won podium places and represented India at Robotex International in Estonia. All from government, rural and tribal schools.
* **STEAM and robotics labs:**
  set up in government schools and colleges through CSR sponsors
* **Innoveda:**
  our future-skills programme for schools and colleges, now expanding to new cities

**The Role**

This is the most important hire we’ll make this year.

You’ll be directly working with the Founder: a senior leader who shares the load across fundraising, grants, operations, growth and outreach, and who owns outcomes end to end. You’ll be handed goals and trusted to get there.

This role suits a seasoned AVP or senior manager from the NGO, CSR or development sector. It also suits an exceptional, qualified Executive Manager or Chief of Staff who is ready to step up and grow into a leadership position. What matters most is ownership, judgement and drive.

You’ll report directly to the Founder & Director and work closely with the programme, finance, outreach and digital teams.

What You’ll Do

1. **Fundraising & CSR Partnerships**

* Build and manage a pipeline of prospective CSR partners, foundations, HNIs and institutional donors
* Research companies’ CSR priorities and Schedule VII alignment, and match them to Robotex India programmes
* Lead pitches from first meeting to signed MoU, with tailored proposals, decks and budgets
* Grow existing partnerships through renewals, expanded scope, multi-year commitments and new geographies
* Manage donor relationships with regular updates, impact stories, site visits and event invitations
* Keep the funding pipeline, forecasts and partner database up to date in a CRM or tracker

2. Grant Management

* Track grant opportunities from CSR, government, multilateral and international funders
* Lead applications from research and concept note through to full proposal and submission
* Own the post-award cycle: deliverables, timelines, milestones and funder commitments
* Prepare progress, impact and financial reports with the programme and finance teams
* Ensure compliance with funder requirements, including utilisation certificates, audit support and CSR-1 / 12A / 80G documentation
* Build a clean, audit-ready grant documentation system

3. Operations

* Oversee programme delivery across states, schools and districts to time, budget and quality
* Coordinate with trainers, coordinators and volunteers for workshops, labs and competitions
* Support the Robotex India National Championship: planning, logistics, partners and team travel for the international finals
* Build SOPs, trackers, dashboards and reviews that let the organisation run without bottlenecks
* Coordinate with finance on budgets, vendor payments, procurement and cost control
* Support hiring, onboarding and performance rhythms for the team

4. Growth & Innoveda Outreach

* Drive Innoveda’s expansion to new schools and cities, from outreach to onboarding
* Open partnerships with school groups, universities, state education departments and Zila Parishads
* Identify new programme and revenue opportunities that strengthen long-term sustainability
* Represent Robotex India at conferences, CSR forums, education events and government meetings

5. Digital Footprint & Communications

* Oversee our social media, website and digital presence with the digital team
* Make sure donors, schools and partners consistently see credible, up-to-date impact stories
* Build impact communications: case studies, annual reports, partner decks and newsletters
* Strengthen Robotex India’s and the Founder’s visibility in media, LinkedIn and sector platforms

6. Founder’s Office

* Manage the Founder’s priorities, calendar, meetings, travel and follow-ups
* Prepare briefs, notes and documents for partner, donor and government meetings
* Track key decisions and commitments, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Act as the Founder’s representative with partners, donors and the team when needed
* Bring fresh thinking: spot problems early, propose solutions and run with them

**What Success Looks Like**

**In your first 30 days:**
you know every programme, partner and grant in our portfolio, and you’ve taken ownership of the funding pipeline and grant calendar.

**In 90 days:**
you’ve closed or renewed CSR partnerships, submitted new grant applications, and put working systems in place for reporting and operations.

**In 12 months:**
Robotex India has a significantly larger donor and CSR base, Innoveda is in new cities, and the Founder’s time is freed up for vision, strategy and relationships.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-haves**

* [7–12] years of experience in NGO, CSR, development sector, EdTech, a founder’s office or a high-growth organisation
* A proven track record in CSR fundraising, donor partnerships or grant management, with funds raised or partnerships closed that you can speak to
* Strong understanding of CSR in India: Schedule VII, CSR-1, 12A / 80G and funder reporting requirements
* Excellent written and spoken English; you can write a proposal that gets funded and an email that gets a reply
* Strong project management and follow-through across many moving parts
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Canva and CRM or tracking tools
* An owner’s mindset: proactive, resourceful and comfortable with ambiguity
* Ability to join immediately and work from our Pune office

**Good to have**

* Postgraduate degree: MBA, MSW, Development Studies, Public Policy or similar
* Existing network among CSR heads, foundations or corporate leaders
* Experience with government partnerships or education programmes
* Familiarity with STEM, future skills, disruptive technologies, robotics or EdTech
* Hindi or Marathi fluency

**Who you are**

* You think in systems but act fast
* You’re as comfortable in a boardroom pitch as in a government school visit
* You bring ideas nobody asked for, and then make them happen
* You care about children’s education and want your work to show up in their lives

**How to Apply**

Apply directly on LinkedIn, or email your CV to
**[**
hr@robotex-india.in
**]**
with the subject line:

**“Application – AVP Partnerships & Operations – [Your Name]”**

Please include:

1. Your CV
2. A short note (5–6 lines) on why this role, and one partnership or grant you’re proud of, with the result
3. Current CTC, expected CTC and the earliest date you can join

**This is an immediate-joining role based in Pune.**
We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, and candidates available to start right away will be prioritised.

*Robotex India is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, and especially encourage women and first-generation professionals to apply.*

description:

 We are seeking a skilled IBM ISIM Consultant to join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team. title: Animator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Skelia Entertainment is a tier\-one international animation studio focused on turnkey production and co\-production of long\-form animated series and episodic content. The studio combines creative storytelling with large\-scale technical execution, partnering with streaming platforms, television networks, and global IP owners. title: Network Operations Consultant
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Senior technical lead for the SOC and for the PulseAI platform layer. Runs major\-incident response for security and PulseAI platform events, owns the detection\-content and tuning program — including Kubernetes/OpenShift security telemetry — and is L3 for PulseAI platform operations: owns root cause analysis, works platform defects with the Gruve PulseAI engineering team, leads OpenShift cluster lifecycle operations and emergency remediation, acts as vendor engineering liaison for Red Hat, the NVIDIA software stack and third\-party platform vendors, partners with the Network Operations Consultant on infrastructure\-side events, and deputises for the Security Operation Manager.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technical response on Severity 1/2 security and PulseAI platform incidents until management command engages; own the SLA status cadence (hourly / every 30 minutes on Severity 1\) to customer authorised contacts; hand infrastructure\-side events (network fabric, GPU hardware, storage) to the Network Operations Consultant and stay engaged on cross\-domain incidents.
* Own root cause analysis for PulseAI platform and OpenShift cluster incidents; reproduce and characterise platform defects and route them to Gruve PulseAI product engineering; own the corrective\-action backlog and problem management to eliminate recurring incidents.
* Own the PulseAI platform operations practice: severity classification standards, diagnostic runbooks for the PulseAI and OpenShift layers (control plane, operators, authentication/SSO, RBAC, tenancy and quota enforcement, model\-serving endpoints, observability), Grafana observability standards, alert thresholds for the SLA appendix, and the monitor / remediate / escalate matrix as applied per customer.
* Lead OpenShift cluster lifecycle operations for PulseAI customers — y\-stream upgrades on customer approval within the agreed window of the Red Hat release, operator and platform\-component changes, emergency vulnerability remediation of the cluster and platform — enforcing the pre\-change backup gate, and coordinating node\-pool, GPU driver/firmware and fabric changes with the Network Operations Consultant.
* Own Kubernetes/OpenShift security operations for the engagement: onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry into the SIEM, detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), Cilium/Hubble and OVN\-Kubernetes flow use cases, admission\-control and image/runtime security posture, and RBAC / service\-account hygiene reviews.
* Act as vendor engineering liaison for the platform stack: Red Hat for OpenShift product defects, NVIDIA for GPU Operator / driver / NVIDIA AI Enterprise (NIM) software issues, and the third\-party platform variant (Rafay, vCluster, vNode, NVIDIA Run:ai, Red Hat OpenShift AI) where restoration is best\-effort with committed vendor escalation.
* Lead customer onboarding technically for the platform layer: deploy and validate OpenShift and PulseAI within the 14\-day Ready\-for\-Install window, configure identity provider federation and initial tenancy structure, onboard the platform to monitoring via the agreed connectivity pattern (outbound collector, site\-to\-site VPN or jump host with just\-in\-time elevation), and complete the platform sections of the countersigned environment validation checklist.
* Own the detection\-content backlog and tuning program; own log\-pipeline integration health with escalation into engineering.
* Approve and execute high\-risk security and platform changes; cross\-train the SOC L1/L2 bench on Kubernetes/OpenShift platform operations; drive shift\-quality audits and post\-incident reviews for the SOC pod.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 8–11 years with prior senior/lead experience in SOC or 24×7 platform operations and genuine security\-to\-platform cross\-domain fluency.
* Incident command capability; deep SIEM content and query skills.
* Strong Kubernetes/GKE security operations depth — onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry, building detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), and tuning Cilium/Hubble\-based use cases.
* Deep Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes operations experience in production — multi\-node cluster administration, operators, y/z\-stream upgrades, RBAC, storage and networking, observability stack (Grafana, metrics, logs, alerting), backup/restore of cluster and platform state — with a track record of platform diagnostics and RCA.
* GPU\-cluster platform operations experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator/driver lifecycle, NVIDIA AI Enterprise components (NIM), DCGM\-class telemetry, node health and capacity management for AI inference workloads on RTX PRO 6000 / HGX B300\-class servers or equivalent.
* Experience operating against contractual SLAs (acknowledgement, restoration, availability, service credits) and running vendor engineering escalations through to fix.
* Working network troubleshooting sufficient to scope cluster\-networking versus fabric faults jointly with the NOC; automation mindset.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced incident\-handling / intrusion\-analysis certification (e.g., GCIH, GCIA, GCFA or equivalent).
* CKS or equivalent; experience running K8s posture/runtime security tooling in production.
* Red Hat certifications (EX280 / EX380 / RHCE); exposure to Rafay, vCluster, NVIDIA Run:ai or Red Hat OpenShift AI; MLOps or AI\-platform operations (model\-serving endpoints, GPU scheduling, quota governance).
* Exposure to HashiCorp Vault, SAML 2\.0 SSO federation, and CSI/NFS storage for model artefacts.
* MSSP/managed\-services background; AI\-SOC tooling exposure.
* Correlating GPU\-platform performance anomalies (utilisation, thermal, fabric saturation) with security events to separate abuse, crypto\-mining or misconfiguration from genuine workload load.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking
 ***Manager Database Operations Manager***
 to join our
 ***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
 in Global Technology \& Operations.
   

  

**Team/Group Description**
 This position operates in a fast\-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On\-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
   

  

**Role Description**
 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
 Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission\-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer\-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high\-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T\-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent \& ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application\-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**
* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase \& IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T\-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.


**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**
* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross\-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high\-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server\-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

 Post\-Production \& File Management

* Select suitable background music as per the mood and brand requirement.
* Export videos in correct formats and sizes as per platform requirements.

 Coordination \& Timelines

* Creative, dependable and detail\-oriented.

* Open to feedback and revisions.

* Interested in hospitality, lifestyle, wellness, travel, food and experience\-led content.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a FinOps Engineer with a DevOps backbone who has an almost obsessive eye for cost leaks, idle resources, and inefficiencies across our platform. If unused EBS volumes, oversized instances, or a forgotten dev environment running on weekends genuinely bother you, you'll fit right in. This isn't a passive reporting role. You'll be expected to proactively hunt for waste, propose optimisations, and drive strategic cost conversations with engineering, SRE, and leadership across ZOOP's entire platform from infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters to data pipelines and third\-party services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuously audit ZOOP's cloud footprint (AWS/Azure/GCP) end\-to\-end compute, storage, networking, databases, observability stack, and SaaS tooling and flag every form of waste, big or small.
* Proactively propose cost\-reduction strategies rather than waiting to be asked; bring data, options, trade\-offs, and a recommendation to the table.
* Lead monthly/quarterly cost reviews with engineering and product leadership; turn billing data into actionable conversations.
* Build cost visibility dashboards and chargeback/showback models so every team at ZOOP knows what they're spending and why.
* Drive rightsizing, autoscaling tuning, Spot/Reserved Instance/Savings Plan strategies, and storage tiering across the platform.
* Embed cost guardrails into CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and Kubernetes manifests to catch wasteful resources before they're deployed.
* Optimise Kubernetes cost efficiency using tools like Kubecost, OpenCost, or Karpenter; tune requests/limits, HPA/VPA, and node pools.
* Set up automated alerts and anomaly detection for budget breaches, idle resources, and runaway costs.
* Partner with Finance for forecasting, unit economics (cost per user/transaction), and cloud budget planning.
* Evangelise a cost\-aware engineering culture, run internal sessions, write playbooks, and make FinOps a shared responsibility, not a finance afterthought.


**Requirements**
* Someone with genuine OCD around cost and wastage; you can't sleep knowing a non\-prod cluster ran all weekend at full capacity.
* A DevOps practitioner first, who understands why costs happen at the infrastructure level, not just someone reading billing reports.
* Naturally proactive; you don't wait for tickets; you spot patterns, dig in, and propose changes before anyone asks.
* Comfortable challenging engineering decisions diplomatically when they're expensive, and equally comfortable defending necessary spend to finance.
* A clear communicator who can talk to both a senior engineer about Karpenter configs and a CFO about quarterly burn.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or Cloud FinOps roles.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred), including native cost tools (Cost Explorer, CUR, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE).
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or Go for automation, reporting, and cost tooling.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Solid grasp of cloud pricing models: On\-Demand, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot/Preemptible, committed\-use discounts.
* SQL skills for querying billing data (AWS CUR via Athena/Redshift, BigQuery billing exports).


**Nice To Have**
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with FinOps platforms (CloudHealth, Cloudability/Apptio, Spot.io, Vantage, Kubecost).
* Exposure to multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud cost optimisation.
* Understanding of SaaS unit economics (cost per customer, cost per transaction, gross margin impact).


 This job was posted by Malavika Kannoth from ZOOP.

 YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
   

  

 At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
   

  

**We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience Level 4\+ Years**
**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


****Required Skills \& Experience****
* 3\+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.


 At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Principal, Enterprise Arch
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining and advancing architecture for Global Engineering. The candidate will be a key member of the Global Engineering Architecture team whose collective responsibility is to enable system development through aligned enterprise strategies, roadmaps, golden paths, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and governance frameworks. This role will partner with executives, enterprise architects, solution architects, application development teams, platform engineering, data, security, and the business. Must demonstrate a proven history of shaping large\-scale technology solutions that address the business objectives of a complex global organization. Ensures that business strategy, market trends, technology evolution, and AI\-enabled opportunities are effectively represented in the organization’s systems, platforms, data architecture, and business processes. Analyzes architectural requirements, defines the vision and target\-state architecture, assesses the current state, establishes transformation roadmaps, governs the project portfolio, and partners with solution architects and engineers to realize the target state.
   

  

 This individual must be delivery\-oriented, enterprise\-minded, and able to influence across senior business, technology, risk, security, and engineering audiences. Must be able to guide strategic direction and make pragmatic decisions that optimize business value, engineering velocity, resiliency, cost, security, regulatory expectations, and risk. Identify reusable platforms, shared engineering capabilities, overlapping functions, and opportunities to converge on standards in order to improve efficiency, quality, developer experience, and time to value across Global Engineering. The preferred candidate will have a broad background in enterprise architecture, application development, cloud\-native delivery, integration, data architecture, AI\-enabled solutions, platform engineering, security, and architecture governance. Must be able to work independently to solve complex problems, create and manage technology roadmaps, and collaborate effectively with a diverse set of partners.
   

  

**Knowledge / Skills**
* Previous or current hands\-on software development experience using modern application development frameworks such as Java/Spring, JavaScript/ReactJS, APIs, cloud\-native services, and engineering automation.
* Significant experience with enterprise architecture patterns, architecture governance, capability modeling, target\-state definition, and enterprise architecture best practices.
* Hands on experience designing and building of cloud\-native architectures; preference using Azure, AWS, Tanzu, and/or Kubernetes
* Deep knowledge of API and microservice style architectures
* Experience shaping AI\-enabled architecture strategies, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, model lifecycle management, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and integration of AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI, AI risk management, model governance, explainability, data privacy, security controls, regulatory considerations, and production observability for AI\-enabled systems.
* Experience using API Management Platforms and Storefronts (e.g. APIGEE, Software AG, etc)
* Experience using Kafka, Solace, and/or MQ for messaging/event streaming
* Deep knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and/or Zachman, with the ability to apply frameworks pragmatically across business, application, data, technology, security, cloud, and AI architecture domains.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, data platforms, metadata, data quality, lineage, and governance capabilities required to support analytics, AI, and enterprise\-scale decisioning; e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Mongo, data lakehouse, and cloud data services.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies and tools such as Agile, product\-oriented delivery, Github, GH Copilot, ADO Boards, Maven/Gradle, CI/CD (Actions), MLOps, LLMOps, and architecture\-as\-code practices.
* Experience with DevOps best practices and toolchain / pipeline automation, Azure DevOps and Atlassian Suite preferred
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and in particular, a broad and deep understanding of products and services provided by Northern Trust.
* Has an understanding of Global Engineering domains, enterprise platforms, software delivery practices, developer experience, cloud enablement, integration, data, security, and operational resiliency in a large financial services environment.
* Strong knowledge of security frameworks and controls.


**Major Duties**
* Define enterprise architecture strategies and target\-state roadmaps that provide business value while reducing complexity, technical debt, operational risk, and duplicated capabilities.
* Mediate conflicting priorities to drive optimal solutions.
* Identify and escalate duplication of effort, functional and technical redundancy, and opportunities to reuse Global Engineering platforms, standards, and shared enterprise capabilities.
* Create reference architectures and reusable patterns for common archetypes, including web, microservice, mobile, third\-party platforms, cloud\-native services, data platforms, AI\-enabled applications, and automation solutions.
* Quickly build proof of concept prototypes with new technologies being researched.
* Establish AI architecture guardrails, responsible AI design patterns, model governance expectations, data readiness criteria, and production readiness standards for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with platform engineering, data, security, risk, and application teams to integrate AI capabilities safely into enterprise platforms and business processes.
* Enable the development organization by creating working examples
* Create cloud, platform, data, and AI\-related frameworks that embed non\-functional requirements, including resiliency, observability, security, privacy, performance, scalability, cost management, and operational supportability.
* Define cloud, platform engineering, DevSecOps, data, and AI delivery best practices for Global Engineering.
* Training technologists and provide project\-based consulting/expertise
* Liaise with Enterprise Architecture, Global Engineering, Security, Data, Risk, Infrastructure, and application delivery groups to align architecture direction and execution.
* Solve problems collaboratively.
* Act as a subject matter expert on technologies and trends in enterprise architecture, cloud, platform engineering, middleware, data, security, infrastructure, generative AI, and AI\-enabled automation.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 12\+ years of technology experience across application development, engineering, architecture, platform, data, cloud, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 8\+ years of enterprise, solution, domain, or platform architecture experience, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and govern architecture decisions at scale.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI, data, automation, cloud, and platform architecture concepts to enterprise transformation, including responsible AI and AI governance considerations.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; MBA or Master’s degree preferred


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Manager, Transaction Services
description:
