**Job Location** 
 : Pimpri\-Chinchwad, Pune
 



  





 We are seeking a Senior Databricks Data Engineer to provide technical leadership for a large\-scale enterprise BI modernization initiative. This is not a lift\-and\-shift migration effort. The role will lead the systematic transformation of a complex Microsoft BI ecosystem (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS) into scalable, governed Databricks Lakehouse architecture.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead the architecture and implementation of enterprise\-scale data pipelines on Databricks.
* Serve as technical lead for the migration of a \~20TB Microsoft SQL Server data warehouse to the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
* Design and implement reusable Spark\-based pipeline frameworks to replace thousands of SSIS workflows.
* Deconstruct SSAS cube logic and redesign it into Lakehouse\-native semantic models.
* Replace legacy SSRS reporting ecosystems with modern, governed analytics layers.
* Rebuild dimensional models within Delta Lake using scalable Lakehouse design patterns.
* Define data modeling standards, ingestion frameworks, CI/CD processes, and operational best practices.
* Implement and enforce Medallion architecture standards (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with performance optimization and governance controls.
* Optimize Spark workloads for scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement governance, lineage, security, and monitoring using Unity Catalog and related platform tooling.
* Mentor engineers, conduct architectural reviews, establish and maintain engineering standards.
* Partner with BI, analytics, and AI/ML teams to enable advanced analytics and downstream use cases.
* Influence platform roadmap and architectural decisions.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 8 – 12 years of data engineering experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building and operating production workloads on Databricks.
* Deep expertise in SQL, PySpark, and distributed data processing.
* Demonstrated leadership in structured enterprise BI modernization programs.
* Proven experience replacing SSIS\-based ETL with scalable Spark\-based frameworks.
* Strong understanding of SSAS cube architecture and semantic layer modernization.
* Experience designing and operating high\-volume, enterprise\-grade analytical data platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Delta Lake, Lakehouse and Medallion architectures, data versioning, and Workflows/Jobs orchestration.
* Experience implementing CI/CD, testing frameworks, and operational reliability for data platforms.
* AWS\-based Databricks experience strongly preferred.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience designing semantic layers and BI integrations (Power BI preferred).
* Exposure to Databricks AI/ML capabilities (MLflow, feature engineering, feature stores).
* Experience establishing enterprise migration patterns across distributed teams.
* Prior technical leadership experience in global or multi\-team environments.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
* Databricks certification is a plus.

title: Recruitment Associate
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?** 




 The quality of school education available to students from low\-income communities across India is abysmal. Their chances of attending college or building a career are significantly lower than their high\-income peers, condemning them to a life without voice or choice. iTeach was born in 2015 to challenge this status quo and create a level playing field for ALL children.
 



  





 We run free and high\-impact schools and an exceptional college\-to\-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai. We are known for our world\-class professional development, our result\-oriented team culture, and our student\-centric school design. Read more about us at
 
 www.iTeachSchools.org
 
 .
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 The Recruitment Associate is a key member of the People Operations team and is responsible for building strong momentum around the secondary education movement and then leveraging it to find the best people for the organization. iTeach’s founding belief is “first who, then what” \- which means that we put all our bets on our people, making this role singularly important to the organization and the students’ success.
 



  





**Selection \& Sourcing \- 60%** 




  




* Drive the end\-to\-end sourcing and initial selection process for assigned roles, ensuring a strong and diverse candidate pipeline.
* Conduct CV screenings, phone/Video screenings and Walk\-ins to assess candidates against role requirements, competencies, and organizational values.
* Use multiple sourcing channels and recruitment portals effectively to identify and attract high\-potential candidates.
* Continuously experiment with innovative sourcing strategies and creative ways to reach and engage candidates, especially for hard\-to\-fill roles.
* Maintain strong candidate engagement, pool and momentum throughout the selection process.



  





**Interview Logistics \& Data Monitoring \- 20%** 




  




* Coordinate with the school Admin/ Principal for on ground interview logistics and ensure a smooth, timely, and positive experience for candidates and selectors.
* Work closely with selectors to ensure interviews are well planned, structured, and completed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment data across all stages of the hiring funnel.
* Use recruitment data and insights to support better decision\-making and continuously improve the hiring process.



  





**Recruitment Projects \& Process Improvement \- 20%** 




  




* Lead and support recruitment projects and initiatives aimed at improving sourcing, selection, candidate experience, and overall recruitment effectiveness.
* Monitor key recruitment metrics such as pipeline health, conversion rates, time\-to\-hire, offer acceptance, and attrition, and identify areas for improvement.
* Bring new ideas, test innovative approaches, and use learnings from recruitment data to continuously improve the organization’s ability to attract and select the right people.



  





**Prerequisites:** 




  




* Required: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree with strong performance.
* Preferred: 1 year of relevant work experience.
* Excellent communication skills \- written and verbal.



  





**Compensation and Benefits:** 
 We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position ranges from 4\.8 \- 6\.0 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing top\-notch industry benefits. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

title: F&A Manager | CA
description:
**Manager – Accounts \& Finance**




**Job Location: Pune (Camp)** 




**Industry: Real Estate / Construction / Promoter \& Developer** 




**Reporting to: Head – Finance / CFO** 




  





**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and technology\-savvy Manager – Accounts \& Finance to lead the Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP\&A and Tax Compliance functions for a leading promoter, developer and construction group in Pune.
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, smooth monthly closing, effective tax compliance, robust MIS and FP\&A support, and efficient utilisation of the organisation’s ERP system. The position will also lead and mentor the accounting team and drive process discipline, automation and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**Accounting \& Financial Reporting** 




 Lead day\-to\-day accounting operations across the group and ensure accuracy, completeness and timely recording of financial transactions.
 



 Drive the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close process.
 



 Review general ledger, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, revenue, costs, receivables, payables and other accounting schedules.
 



 Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for construction projects, development activities, land transactions, project costs and related\-party transactions.
 



 Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
 



  





**MIS, FP\&A \& Business Support** 




 Lead preparation of monthly MIS, project\-wise profitability reports, budgets, forecasts, cash\-flow projections and variance analysis.
 



 Provide meaningful financial insights to management on project performance, costs, margins, working capital and cash flows.
 



 Develop and improve management dashboards and analytical reports to support business decision\-making.
 



 Work closely with project, commercial, procurement and business teams to ensure timely and accurate financial information.
 



  





**Tax \& Statutory Compliance** 




 Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance, including GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements.
 



 Ensure timely filing of returns, payments, reconciliations and responses to tax/statutory queries.
 



 Coordinate with external tax advisors, auditors and consultants wherever required.
 



 Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the business.
 



  





**ERP \& Process Management** 




 Take ownership of the ERP system from a finance and accounting perspective and ensure smooth and effective utilisation by the accounting and business teams.
 



 Work with ERP teams/consultants to configure processes, improve controls and develop MIS reports.
 



 Should have the ability to understand business requirements and design/define ERP\-based MIS and reporting solutions.
 



 Experience with ERP platforms such as Highrise, SAP or equivalent will be an advantage.
 



 Drive standardisation, automation, internal controls and continuous improvement of finance processes.
 



  





**Audit \& Compliance** 




 Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
 



 Maintain appropriate documentation and supporting schedules for audit and management review.
 



 Strengthen financial controls and ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Lead, guide and motivate the accounting team to deliver accurate, timely and reliable financial information.
 



 Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and develop team capabilities.
 



 Establish a process\-oriented and accountability\-driven culture within the finance function.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies**




 In\-depth knowledge of accounting, financial reporting and month\-end/year\-end close processes.
 



 Strong understanding of the real estate, construction, promoter and developer business, including project accounting and project\-wise financial analysis.
 



 Strong knowledge of FP\&A, MIS, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
 



 Good understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances relevant to the business.
 



 Strong ERP knowledge with the ability to use technology for process improvement and MIS development.
 



 Experience with Highrise, SAP or similar ERP systems will be preferred.
 



 Technology\-savvy and comfortable working with ERP, reporting tools, Excel and data\-driven financial analysis.
 



 Strong process orientation, attention to detail and analytical ability.
 



 Excellent people\-management, communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a fast\-paced business environment.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience**




 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5 years of post qualification experience or completion of CA article ship with 10 years of experience in leading the accounting/finance function.
 



 Candidates with substantial experience in a real estate, construction, promoter or developer organization will be strongly preferred.
 



 Proven experience in managing accounting teams and delivering monthly MIS, financial close, statutory compliance and management reporting.
 



  





**Key Success Measures**




 Timely and accurate monthly financial close.
 



 Quality and timeliness of MIS and management reporting.
 



 Effective project\-wise financial and cost reporting.
 



 Timely statutory and tax compliance.
 



 Smooth and effective ERP operations.
 



 Strong financial controls and audit readiness.
 



 Improved finance processes, automation and reporting.
 



 Effective leadership and development of the accounting team.

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!
   

  

**What We Do…**
 We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world\-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online \- quickly and simply.
   

  

 We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.
   

  

 And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 56,000 hotels in 150\+ countries \- with over 140 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.
   

  

**About The Data Engineering Lead Role…**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Data Engineering Lead to provide technical direction and people leadership for a small team of data engineers. You will help shape the evolution of SiteMinder’s cloud data platform while continuing to contribute directly to the design and delivery of data engineering solutions.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role. You will spend approximately 70% of your time on data engineering projects and 30% on Data Operations, reliability, and support. You will work across Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Terraform, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
   

  

 You will partner with engineering, product, finance, commercial, and analytics stakeholders to turn business needs into trusted, maintainable data solutions. You will also help establish the engineering standards, operating practices, and team capabilities needed to scale our data platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
**Technical leadership**
* Set technical direction for data engineering projects and make pragmatic architecture decisions
* Lead design reviews and establish reusable patterns for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data modelling, testing, deployment, and observability
* Promote engineering best practices across code quality, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, security, documentation, and operational readiness
* Guide the adoption and effective use of Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, and supporting platform technologies
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, data quality, and cost efficiency
* Provide hands\-on technical contribution to complex data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and production issues


**People leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a small team of data engineers through regular feedback, goal\-setting, mentoring, and career development
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and capability planning for the team
* Create an environment of ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
* Help team members make sound technical decisions while encouraging autonomy and accountability


**Delivery and stakeholder partnership**
* Own or contribute to the delivery of data engineering initiatives from discovery and design through implementation and production support
* Translate business and analytical requirements into robust data products and well\-defined delivery plans
* Build strong functional knowledge of SiteMinder’s systems and business processes, including applications such as Salesforce and Zuora
* Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Participate in data discovery, deep\-dive analysis, and investigation of complex data issues, communicating findings and recommended actions clearly


**Data Operations and reliability**
* Help operate and support production data pipelines, datasets, and integrations within agreed service levels.
* Establish effective monitoring, alerting, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and problem\-management practices.
* Improve data quality through automated testing, validation, reconciliation, lineage, and documentation.
* Manage operational requests and prioritise ad hoc analysis based on business impact and urgency.
* Identify recurring operational issues and convert them into sustainable engineering improvements rather than manual workarounds


**What You Have…**
**Technical Experience**
* Significant professional experience in data engineering, including experience leading technical delivery or mentoring engineers
* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms, including Databricks and/or Snowflake, and production experience with dbt
* Experience designing and implementing data platforms using medallion or comparable layered architecture patterns
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with practical experience writing, testing, debugging, and optimising production data pipelines
* Experience with data modelling, dimensional modelling, data warehousing, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and analytical data products
* Experience building and operating complete ETL or ELT processes, including ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
* Practical experience with Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code approach
* Experience building bespoke integrations using Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies
* Strong understanding of data reliability, observability, security, access control, and cost management
* Experience working with AWS data services and the ability to choose appropriate services for a given use case


**Leadership and collaboration**
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, make clear technical decisions, and create alignment across teams
* Experience coaching engineers and raising engineering standards across a team
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills
* A structured and analytical approach to problem\-solving, with sound judgment when working independently
* Experience working effectively with geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams
* A practical, delivery\-focused mindset suited to a growing technology organisation


**Nice to have**
* Experience with streaming or event\-driven data platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with AWS services such as Glue, EMR, and Kinesis
* Experience with Spark and large\-scale distributed data processing
* Experience with change data capture, near\-real\-time ingestion, or integration with OLTP systems
* Experience with data governance, data contracts, metadata management, lineage, or master data concepts
* Experience supporting a migration between data platforms, such as Snowflake and Databricks
* Experience in the SaaS, travel, hospitality, or marketplace sectors


**Our Perks \& Benefits…**
* Mental health and well\-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in\-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

 When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

**Job Summary**
 Sr Test Analyst for a global technology organization responsible for designing and executing comprehensive manual test strategies across Azure based IoT solutions and DevOps enabled delivery pipelines. Work model is hybrid with day shift and no travel requirement.

* Design detailed manual test plans and test cases for complex Azure based IoT platforms ensuring thorough coverage of device connectivity data flows security and performance aspects.

title: Executive Assistant - Chairman’s Office
description:
**Chief of Staff – Chairman’s Office** 




**Location: Pune** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time \| On\-site** 




**Experience: 8–15 years** 




**Reporting to: Chairman** 




  





**Role Objective** 




**This is a high\-trust, high\-ownership role working directly with the Chairman.** 




**The mandate is simple:** 




  





**Take work out of the Chairman’s head and return only finished output.** 




**Not updates. Not effort. Outcomes.** 




**The Chief of Staff will convert discussions into action, action into accountability, and accountability into closure—ensuring that important priorities keep moving even when the Chairman is travelling, in meetings, or unavailable.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Attend meetings with the Chairman, capture decisions accurately, and drive agreed actions to closure.**
* **Take complete ownership of assigned topics, projects, reviews, and special initiatives; execute independently from start to finish.**
* **Keep critical priorities moving when the Chairman is travelling, in meetings, or unavailable.**
* **Drive internal teams, senior managers, vendors, consultants, and external stakeholders without repeated reminders.**
* **Convert discussions, data, and reviews into clear, decision\-ready notes, presentations, analysis, action plans, and recommendations.**
* **Identify issues early, resolve them wherever possible, and escalate only with clear options and proposed solutions.**
* **Manage and coordinate the Chairman’s travel, meeting preparation, itineraries, and logistics; accompany the Chairman when business requirements demand it.**
* **Support key hiring, leadership and performance reviews, strategic projects, and cross\-functional business initiatives.**
* **Maintain a strong follow\-up rhythm so that important commitments, decisions, and deadlines never fall through the cracks.**
* **Handle sensitive business, people, commercial, and strategic matters with absolute confidentiality, discretion, and sound judgement.**



**Who This Role Is For** 




**You are likely to succeed in this role if you have:** 



* **Worked closely with a Founder, Promoter, Chairman, CEO, or business owner.**
* **Demonstrated strong ownership, follow\-through, stakeholder management, and execution ability.**
* **The ability to work calmly and decisively under pressure, ambiguity, and direct feedback.**
* **A proactive operating style: you anticipate what needs to happen next rather than waiting for instructions.**
* **The confidence and maturity to drive senior colleagues, teams, vendors, and external stakeholders to deliver.**
* **Strong written and analytical ability, with the capability to create crisp presentations, decision notes, recommendations, and reviews.**
* **Sound judgement on what to resolve independently and what requires escalation to the Chairman.**
* **A mindset focused on outcomes—not activity, reporting, or effort.**



**Relevant backgrounds include Founder’s Office, Chief of Staff, consulting, PMO, real estate or infrastructure execution, family office operations, strategic business roles, or senior EA roles with strong execution exposure.** 




  





**Who Should Not Apply** 




**This role is not suited to candidates seeking a position limited primarily to:** 



* **Secretarial, calendar\-management, or administrative support.**
* **MIS preparation, reporting, coordination, or tracker management without ownership of final outcomes.**
* **Work that requires constant direction, repeated follow\-ups, or detailed instruction.**
* **A low\-pressure environment with limited accountability, urgency, or stakeholder\-management responsibility.**



**Candidates from senior EA or executive\-office backgrounds are welcome if they have independently driven projects, stakeholders, decisions, and closure—not only administrative support.** 




  





**The Test** 




**If your natural response to a difficult or ambiguous task is:** 




  





**“I’ll take care of it.”** 




**—and you actually do, this role is for you.** 




  





**Application** 




**Please share your CV along with:** 



* **Current CTC**
* **Expected CTC**

 Cummins is seeking a dynamic and innovative Employer Branding \& Process Excellence Manager to support Talent Acquisition across India and the Pacific region.  Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* Develop and maintain talent acquisition dashboards, reports, and insights.

* Lead cross\-functional projects and Talent Acquisition initiatives.

title: Consultant
description:
**Forward Deployed Consultant** 




**Future Fabric \| Organisation Design \& Talent Advisory** 




**Pune \| Work from Office** 




  





**Org. \& Talent Consultant** 
 who provides end\-to\-end solutions and support inside the client to bring about real change – especially in the areas of
 **Org. Design, Performance \& Talent Management, Rewards Design** 









**Why this role exists** 




 At People Equation, we believe the best consulting involves not only solutioning but stays close enough to see change happen.
 



 Our consultants work alongside leadership teams and HR functions inside the client's context, helping solve organisation and talent challenges from diagnosis through implementation. We combine strategic thinking with operational capabilities and remain engaged until solutions become part of the way the organisation works.
 



  





 We call this our
 **Forward\-Deployed Consulting** 
 model.
 



  





 Our work for clients spans four interconnected dimensions:
 


* **Org. Design \& Talent Solutions —** 
 Design organisation structures and operating models, workforce planning, build job and career architecture, design performance \& talent management processes, and rewards design.
* **Deployment \& Change —** 
 Help organisations deploy the solutions and adopt, embed and sustain change through practical implementation, stakeholder engagement and capability building.
* **HR Partnering \& Operations —** 
 Work alongside client business and HR teams (as a project / in fractional capacity) to ensure operational efficiencies, compliant functioning, and the right culture and employee experience.
* **Recruitment —** 
 Strengthen organisations through executive search and recruitment advisory that ensure right people are in the right roles.



  





**What you'll do** 




 You'll work directly with client leadership on organisation and talent challenges. Your core work:
 


* **Organisation \& Operating Model Design** 
 — structure, spans and layers, role charters, design options and trade\-offs; and how work, decisions and accountabilities flow across the organisation
* **Workforce Planning** 
 — demand and supply modelling, productivity, cost\-to\-serve, build / buy / borrow choices
* **Performance \& Talent Management** 
 – philosophy \& process design, performance scorecards, performance \& potential assessment, talent review
* **Job Architecture and Career Frameworks** 
 — job families, job levelling, career architecture
* **Rewards Design** 
 — grades and bands, benchmarking, incentive and variable pay structures



  





 You may also contribute across the wider practice:
 


* Leadership development, culture and change
* HR transformation and fractional HR services (including operations, compliance)
* Learning and development
* Executive search and mid\-level recruitment, as part of broader client solutions



 Apart from project work, you will support client accounts, help strengthen the assets / IP of the practice, and build capability in fellow consultants.
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 We're looking for consultants who enjoy solving business problems through people solutions. Typically, you'll bring:
 


* **4 \- 5 years of experience** 
 across HR consulting and HR COEs / business partnering
* Hands\-on project depth in organisation design, operating models, workforce planning, performance management, job architecture or compensation design.
* Practical exposure to HR operations and business partnering
* Working knowledge of executive search, recruitment or talent acquisition
* Strong facilitation, communication and structured problem\-solving skills
* Comfort with data — able to build and defend a model in Excel, and read market benchmarking well
* Intermediate or higher\-level skills in AI and the ability to leverage it to improve impact



  





**Success looks like** 




 Within your first year, you'll have:
 


* Led organisation design or workforce planning workstreams from diagnosis through implementation
* Delivered design artefacts clients actually adopt — structures, scorecards, architecture, pay frameworks
* Become a trusted advisor to multiple client leaders
* Delivered measurable business and people outcomes
* Contributed to People Equation's consulting IP and AI\-enabled ways of working
* Built lasting client relationships that lead to repeat opportunities



  





**What this role is not** 




 This isn't a strategy\-only consulting role, nor is it purely an HRBP, L\&D or recruitment role.
 



 It's for consultants who enjoy staying close to clients, solving real organisational problems through advisory \& services, and creating lasting change.
 








**The details** 




**Location:** 
 Pune, work from office (with reasonable flexibility)
 



**Career Level:** 
 Consultant, reporting to Partner
 



**Contact:** 
 If you are interested, write to
 
 yajna.d@peopleequation.io
 




  





  





**People Equation**
 is a boutique advisory firm specializing in Organization \& Talent, Applied AI, and GCCs and helping organizations thrive in the age of AI.

title: Senior Marketplaces Advertising Strategist..
description:
This is not a reporting seat or an execution\-only role. You will own the advertising performance of your accounts end\-to\-end — strategy, targets, partner relationship, and outcomes — and act as the eyes and ears of the ads function on the ground. That means proactively surfacing risks, opportunities, and optimisation calls before partners or leadership have to ask, and translating what the data is telling us into decisions and action.
   

  

**You will work side\-by\-side with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead, supporting them to deliver against team\-level commercial targets while running your own book of accounts with autonomy. You will be hands\-on across Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and equally comfortable leading a partner conversation about commercial strategy as you are inside a bid management interface.**
 ₹0 \- ₹0 a year
   

  

**Account Ownership \& Strategy Leadership**
* Own a portfolio of strategic brand accounts end\-to\-end — you are the senior strategist accountable for advertising performance against agreed commercial targets (revenue, ROAS, TACoS, new\-to\-brand, share of voice)
* Define quarterly and monthly advertising strategies for each account, aligned to partner commercial goals — growth, profitability, launches, defence, and category share
* Lead the advertising conversation in partner meetings, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly business reviews — own the narrative on what happened, why, what we are doing next, and what to expect
* Be the eyes and ears of the ads function — proactively flag what is working, what is at risk, and what to do about it, ahead of partners or leadership asking
* Partner with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead to hit portfolio\-level targets; raise pacing, performance, and budget risks early and bring the recommended call, not just the problem


**Campaign Strategy \& Optimisation**
* Plan, execute, and monitor paid advertising campaigns on Amazon (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) and Amazon DSP for your strategic accounts
* Lead optimisation across the portfolio — campaign structure, keyword strategy, negatives, bid strategy, audience targeting, creative direction, and budget pacing
* Test, scale, and retire — design structured tests (bid, placement, creative, audience), interpret results with rigour, and roll winners into the playbook
* Plan and manage weekly and monthly advertising budgets across your accounts; keep spend on pace and on strategy
* Continuously improve the tracking of brand\-level ad spend and return on ad spend, and the way we report performance to partners


**Amazon Marketing Cloud, DSP \& Advanced Advertising**
* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) as a core part of how you build strategy — path\-to\-conversion, audience overlap, incrementality, new\-to\-brand analysis
* Run and interpret Amazon DSP campaigns and analytics — quantify how upper\-funnel activity contributes to lower\-funnel conversions and feed that back into the plan
* Stay ahead of the Amazon advertising roadmap — beta features, new ad types, AMC releases — and bring the relevant ones into how we operate


**Partner \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Communicate with partners via email, calls, and face\-to\-face meetings — bring insight, not just updates
* Define compelling advertising strategies that meet partner commercial goals and articulate them clearly to non\-specialist audiences
* Work closely with Brand Management, Merchandising, and SEO/Content to drive an aligned commercial agenda for your accounts — advertising is one lever, not the whole story


**Team \& Function**
* Train, develop, and coach more junior strategists and the offshore execution team — quality\-check work, raise the bar on standards, and build playbooks others can reuse
* Support the Lead on partner escalations, portfolio reviews, and strategic initiatives across the team
* Adopt internal tools and feed requirements back to the tech team to make the team faster and sharper


**Must\-Have**
* 5\+ years of total experience, with 3\+ years in a hands\-on digital advertising role on Amazon — agency, accelerator, or in\-house at a meaningful scale
* Demonstrable track record of owning accounts and carrying performance targets — you have held a number and hit it, not just reported on one
* Deep working knowledge of the Amazon advertising ecosystem — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) — or strong fluency in clean\-room / advanced advertising analytics and willingness to certify within the first 90 days
* Line management or senior mentoring experience — you have raised the performance of people around you
* Strategic thinker with a strong commercial bias — you can connect a bid adjustment to a P\&L outcome and explain it to a non\-specialist
* Excellent verbal and written communication — you can lead a partner conversation and write a sharp performance narrative
* Excellent analytical skills, including budget management and attention to detail
* Proactive and self\-directed — comfortable operating with autonomy across a portfolio and raising your hand before being asked


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with retail / ecommerce brands across multiple categories
* Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) certification
* Working knowledge of SQL for advertising data analysis
* Experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight)
* Experience working with offshore execution teams or across geographies

* Understanding of security hardening guidelines and enterprise network policies.

* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.

* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts and provide on\-call support.


 Educational Qualification
   

  

* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics \& Communication, or equivalent.
* Diploma holders with relevant enterprise networking experience may also be considered.

* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)

description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 As a Lead Security Research Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for vulnerability research, exploit analysis, exposure validation, and vulnerability signature development across the Qualys security platform. You will lead initiatives to identify, validate, and prioritise security risks based on real\-world exploitability, helping customers distinguish theoretical exposures from confirmed attack paths.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Lead vulnerability research initiatives across operating systems, databases, enterprise applications, cloud services, container platforms, and network devices.
* Research newly disclosed, N\-day, and actively exploited vulnerabilities.
* Lead the development of exploit\-based exposure validation techniques to confirm real\-world exploitability of vulnerabilities.
* Review technical designs, research methodologies, and code contributions to ensure quality and consistency.
* Partner with Engineering and Product teams to influence roadmap decisions and security content strategy.
* Design safe and controlled validation mechanisms that emulate attacker behavior without affecting production systems.
* Analyze vulnerability root causes, attack vectors, exploitability conditions, and potential business impact.
* Mentor and guide Security Research Engineers on vulnerability analysis, exploit analysis, and signature creation.
* Build validation logic capable of determining whether existing security controls such as WAFs, firewalls, EDRs, IPS, and compensating controls effectively prevent exploitation.
* Drive automation initiatives for vulnerability research, exploit validation, content generation, testing, and release processes.
* Establish best practices, coding standards, and quality guidelines for signature development.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (or equivalent experience).
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in vulnerability research, penetration testing, detection engineering, or security research.
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SSH, SMTP, DNS, SSL/TLS, and modern web protocols.
* Strong expertise in vulnerability analysis, exploit development, and attack techniques.
* Extensive knowledge of operating systems, databases, web technologies, cloud environments, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Strong coding background.
* Experience with packet analysis, network troubleshooting, and protocol reverse engineering.
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, common attack techniques, and modern threat actor tactics.
* Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience leading projects and mentoring technical teams.


**Additional Plus Competencies:**
 Understanding of Lua (preferred), Bash, or Python.
   

  

 Knowledge of Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Oracle, etc.).
   

  

 Proficient with regular expressions.
   

  

 Knowledge of container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
   

  

 Experienced in the use of vulnerability scanners, IDS, and security tools.
   

  

 OSCP, CISSP, or SANS GIAC certifications.

**What You Need \-** 



* 3\+ years running paid performance marketing for the US market, with real hands\-on ownership \- not just vendor management.
* Direct experience in mortgage, lending, fintech, insurance, or another regulated, high\-CAC lead\-gen vertical strongly preferred.

* Fluency in attribution: GTM, GA4, UTM discipline, and CRM/CDP integration \- GoHighLevel experience a strong plus.
* Comfort with the numbers: CAC, LTV, ROAS math, building your own reporting in Excel/Sheets.
* Working knowledge of financial\-services advertising restrictions (Special Ad Category, TCPA, similar).



  





**Nice to have \-** 



* Experience scaling a channel from under $10M/month to $50\-100M/month in pipeline or revenue terms.
* Worked directly with sales/loan officer teams to improve lead quality, not just lead volume.

description:
**\[Apply through the Excel sheet]**
 https://forms.gle/Z4RqYZAmced1z5Ft5
   

  

 \~\~\~
   

  

 BDTC is a private limited company established in 2013 in Pune. It was founded by Avinash Anand Singh who is an international acclaimed peak performance coach. The company runs series of workshops and have participants from 9\+ countries. The company is standing at a verge of explosive growth and scale. Hence, we are looking for bright and skilled people to join the team.
   

  

 BDTC helps people move through a structured personal transformation journey — from an introductory program through to a deeper, immersive residential experience.
   

  

 A Program Counsellor is the human bridge in that journey: the person who speaks with someone who's shown interest, understands where they actually are in their life and what's holding them back, and helps them see clearly whether this program is the right next step for them — and if so, guides them to commit.
   

  

 This is a conversation\-first, relationship\-first role. A strong, structured sense of how to guide someone from interest to decision matters more than any specific industry background.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Personally own a pipeline of prospective participants from first conversation through to enrollment, staying accountable for outcomes at every stage.
   

  

 Have genuine, structured conversations that understand a person's situation, motivations, and hesitations before recommending anything.
   

  

 Address doubts and concerns (cost, timing, family buy\-in, uncertainty) honestly and with patience, helping people make a decision they feel good about, not one they're pushed into

title: Life Coach
description:
**Company Description** 
 Atmantan Wellness Centre is a luxury wellness destination nestled in the crystal hills and overlooking the pristine Mulshi Lake, offering a tranquil environment for holistic healing. The centre focuses on integrated wellness for mind, body, and soul, combining modern science with traditional practices. Guests come for personalized wellness programs, including lifestyle transformation, stress management, and overall health optimization. Team members work in a serene, nature\-rich setting that supports both guest well\-being and professional growth for wellness practitioners.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Life Coach at Atmantan Wellness Centre is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune District. The Life Coach will conduct one\-on\-one and small\-group coaching sessions to help guests set realistic goals, build healthy habits, and overcome personal and professional challenges. Daily activities include assessing guest needs, creating tailored action plans, documenting progress, and coordinating with wellness, fitness, and therapy professionals to deliver integrated programs. The Life Coach will facilitate workshops on topics such as stress management, emotional resilience, motivation, and work\-life balance, while maintaining high standards of confidentiality and ethical practice. The role also involves providing ongoing support and follow\-up, contributing to program development, and promoting a positive, supportive environment aligned with Atmantan’s wellness philosophy.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong coaching and counseling skills, including goal\-setting, active listening, and motivational interviewing.
* Ability to design and deliver structured wellness or personal development programs and group workshops.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a compassionate, non\-judgmental approach.
* Knowledge of stress management, mindfulness, behavior change, and holistic wellness concepts.
* Relevant certification or training in life coaching, counseling, psychology, or a related field; a bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* Experience working in wellness, hospitality, healthcare, or similar client\-facing environments is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in the Pune District, with flexibility for weekend or holiday schedules as needed.
* Strong organizational skills, professionalism, and commitment to ethical guidelines and confidentiality.

title: Educational Consultant
description:
**About Application Ally** 




 Application Ally is a boutique education consulting firm that provides highly personalized guidance to students navigating the global admissions process. We combine thoughtful mentorship, strategic advice, and meticulous application support to help students present their strongest and most authentic candidacy.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Education Consultant to support students applying primarily to Master’s programs around the world, with a particular focus on universities in the US and UK.
 



 This is a multifaceted role combining graduate admissions consulting, writing and editing, student mentorship, and project and program management. You will guide students through the entire application journey: from early\-stage planning and university selection to developing application materials and managing final submissions.
 



  





 You will also contribute to broader initiatives such as student workshops, school and institutional partnerships, and internal programs and projects. We welcome candidates with direct admissions experience, as well as accomplished writers, communicators, and project managers from other professional backgrounds who are excited about working in education."
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




*Graduate Admissions Consulting* 



* Guide students through the end\-to\-end graduate application process, primarily for Master’s programs.
* Help students identify suitable universities and programs based on their academic background, professional goals, interests, and preferences.
* Develop individualized application strategies, timelines, and action plans.
* Support students in shaping compelling personal narratives across their applications.
* Provide detailed guidance and editorial feedback on statements of purpose, personal statements, essays, résumés, and other application materials.
* Prepare students for admissions interviews where required.
* Track multiple application requirements and deadlines, ensuring that each application is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
* Communicate regularly with students.



*Project and Program Management* 



* Plan and conduct workshops, information sessions, and other student\-facing programs.
* Support projects involving colleges, counsellors, and institutional partners.
* Coordinate timelines, stakeholders, communications, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with the Application Ally team to ensure a consistently high standard of service.
* Contribute ideas for improving student resources, programs, workflows, and internal processes.
* Take ownership of assigned projects and follow them through from planning to delivery.



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 



* An exceptional writer and editor with a strong command of English.
* A polished, thoughtful, and highly effective communicator.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple students, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* An attentive listener who can understand a student’s experiences and help them communicate their story authentically.
* Detail\-oriented, dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership.
* Able to provide candid, constructive, and empathetic feedback.
* Comfortable working collaboratively as part of a close\-knit team.
* Interested in higher education and motivated by helping students achieve meaningful academic and professional goals.



  





**Experience** 




 We are flexible about years of experience and will evaluate candidates based on the strength and relevance of their overall profile.
 



 Previous experience in graduate admissions, education consulting, counselling, writing, editing, communications, project management, program management, or a related field is valuable but not essential. Strong writers and project managers seeking to transition into education consulting are encouraged to apply.
 



  





**Why Join Application Ally?** 



* Do meaningful, high\-impact work with students at an important stage in their academic and professional journeys.
* Work in a boutique environment where every student receives personalized attention.
* Take on a varied role spanning consulting, mentorship, writing, workshops, partnerships, and program delivery.
* Join a collaborative team that values excellent work, thoughtful communication, and continuous learning.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Please apply through LinkedIn with your résumé or email it to anushkadesai@applicationally.net.

 Manage interactions efficiently and provide timely, accurate resolutions to drive customer satisfaction and retention.
   

  

* Domain \& Technical Proficiency

 Troubleshoot and resolve customer\-reported issues across applications and systems, using a structured and analytical approach; familiarity with HCM domains such as US Payroll, Time \& Labor, and HR is a strong plus.

 0–2 years of hands\-on experience with US Payroll or HR systems. (Preferred but not required)
   

  

* Performance \& Productivity Focus

title: Copilot Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role: Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio**
**Position Summary**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team designs and deploys AI‑enabled solutions that transform audit and assurance workflows at scale. As a
 **Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio** 
 , you will be responsible for designing, engineering, testing, and governing high‑quality prompts, agents, and conversational workflows that power Microsoft Copilot–based solutions for Assurance professionals.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of
 **Assurance domain knowledge, Generative AI behaviour, and Microsoft Copilot platform engineering** 
 . You will ensure Copilot solutions are
 **accurate, explainable, safe, compliant, and engagement‑ready** 
 , while delivering measurable productivity and quality outcomes for audit teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Prompt Engineering \& AI Behaviour Design**
* Design, refine, and optimize prompts for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to support audit, controls, risk, and reporting use cases.
* Engineer multi‑turn conversational flows, system prompts, grounding instructions, and response constraints aligned to Assurance methodology.
* Apply prompt patterns such as role‑based prompting, chain‑of‑thought structuring, guardrails, and retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG).
* Continuously test and improve prompt performance for accuracy, consistency, explainability, and hallucination reduction.


**Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio Engineering**
* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents including topics, triggers, entities, actions, plugins, and orchestration logic.
* Integrate Copilot Studio with enterprise data sources, workflows, APIs, and assurance tools in line with security and governance standards.
* Design agent routing and orchestration logic to support multi‑agent or domain‑specific Copilot experiences.
* Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to align Copilot implementations with Microsoft and EY architectural standards.


**AI Quality, Risk \& Governance**
* Define and execute AI testing strategies including prompt validation, negative testing, edge‑case handling, and output evaluation.
* Ensure Copilot solutions meet AI governance, risk management, and compliance expectations (e.g., explainability, traceability, human‑in‑the‑loop).
* Support AI certification, QRM reviews, and engagement‑readiness assessments for Copilot‑based solutions.
* Document prompt logic, assumptions, limitations, and usage guidance for audit and risk review purposes.


**Adoption, Change \& Enablement**
* Support rollout of Copilot solutions through user guidance, prompt playbooks, and best‑practice documentation.
* Train Assurance users on effective Copilot interaction and responsible usage.
* Gather user feedback and usage insights to iteratively improve prompt effectiveness and agent design.


**Research \& Continuous Improvement**
* Stay current on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, and emerging prompt engineering techniques.
* Evaluate new Copilot features and GenAI capabilities for applicability to Assurance use cases.
* Contribute to reusable prompt libraries, agent templates, and design standards across the Assurance Digital portfolio.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 4–7 years of experience in AI‑enabled product, automation, or digital roles.
* Hands‑on experience with prompt engineering for LLM‑based systems.
* Practical experience building solutions using Microsoft Copilot and/or Copilot Studio, Python, LangGraph.
* Strong understanding of LLM behaviour, limitations, risks, and evaluation techniques.
* Ability to translate complex business or regulatory requirements into structured AI interactions.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models with cross‑functional global teams.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to explain AI behaviour to non‑technical stakeholders.


**Preferred / Additional Capabilities**
* Familiarity with Assurance, Audit, Risk, or Regulatory workflows.
* Experience with RAG patterns, vector search, and enterprise data grounding.
* Exposure to AI governance, risk management, or model validation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Azure services and API‑based integrations.
* Ability to create conversation flows, prompt maps, and AI interaction diagrams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Copilot solutions that deliver trusted, high‑quality, audit‑ready outputs.
* Prompts and agents that are reusable, scalable, and compliant by design.
* Strong adoption and positive feedback from Assurance practitioners.
* Reduced rework, improved efficiency, and enhanced audit quality through AI assistance.

 ● Schedule internal and external meetings across India and US time zones.

 and attention to detail.

 Global and partner collaboration — Build trusted relationships with global leaders and implementation partners. Establish governance, enablement, quality controls, escalation paths, and shared accountability for consistent customer outcomes.

 Customer outcomes, adoption, value realization, and satisfaction
   

  

 Time to value, go\-live predictability, delivery quality, and risk reduction
   

  

 Productivity, utilization, capacity planning, forecast accuracy, and financial performance
   

  

 AI and automation adoption, administrative effort reduced, and repeatable work industrialized
   

  

 Employee engagement, capability growth, leadership depth, and partner performance

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
   

  

 7\+ years of senior leadership experience in SaaS delivery, implementation services, professional services, or enterprise services.
   

  

 Demonstrated success leading transformational change and scaling implementation or professional services teams in India.

 Experience leading complex, multi\-region implementations across SMB, mid\-market, and enterprise segments, with strong HCM/WFM domain knowledge.
   

  

 Proven ability to define and deliver customer value outcomes beyond implementation completion or technical go\-live.
   

  

 Experience using AI, automation, analytics, and digital tools to improve efficiency, decision quality, and customer experience.
   

  

 Strong financial and operational acumen, including budgets, forecasts, utilization, capacity planning, and business performance; able to operate across cultures and time zones.
   

  

 Exceptional communication, influencing, coaching, and relationship\-building skills, with an innovative, entrepreneurial mindset and bias toward action.
   

  

 Willingness and ability to travel as required and work flexibly across time zones.
   

  

 The UKG difference
   

  

 You will help build a modern delivery organization that is powered by AI, scaled through global delivery centers, extended by partners, and elevated by advisory services. title: Senior Patch Research Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Qualys is looking for a detail\-oriented Windows Patch Management Catalog Researcher to join the Patch Management product team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining a comprehensive, accurate patch catalog covering a wide range of third\-party Windows software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Patch Catalog Research \& Authoring


 Research, author, and maintain patch metadata for third\-party Windows applications across a broad software catalog.
   

  

 Identify new software releases, security updates, and version changes from vendor sources, changelogs, and security advisories (CVE/NVD).
   

  

 Map vendor releases to structured metadata schemas, including version strings, download URLs, detection logic, and installation parameters.
   

  

 Track software End\-of\-Life (EOL) dates and update catalog entries accordingly.
   

  

* Windows Patching \& Installation Knowledge


 Document and validate silent installation parameters for diverse installer types (MSI, NSIS EXE, InnoSetup, WiX, etc.).
   

  

 Research and verify correct msiexec.exe flags, NSIS /S switches, and equivalent silent/unattended arguments per software.
   

  

 Determine accurate reboot behavior (Yes / No / Maybe) per installer type and document exit codes (success, reboot\-required).
   

  

 Manually test patch installation in sandbox environments and verify detection logic post\-install.
   

  

* Detection Logic \& Registry Research


 Research and validate Windows registry keys used to detect installed software versions (Uninstall hive, vendor\-specific keys, DisplayVersion, etc.).
   

  

 Identify and document file\-based detection paths (FileVersion, ProductVersion attributes on key executables).
   

  

 Understand the difference between 32\-bit and 64\-bit registry views (WOW6432Node) and apply correct detection architecture per installer variant.
   

  

 Validate detection logic against fresh installs and upgrades across supported Windows versions.
   

  

* Backend Patch Tool Understanding


 Understand how enterprise patch management platforms (e.g., Qualys Patch Management, SCCM, Ivanti, Adaptiva) discover, deploy, and verify patches.
   

  

 Familiarity with how catalogs are consumed by patch engines — detection\-before\-install logic, supersedence evaluation, and deployment policy enforcement.
   

  

* Required Skills \& Qualifications


 4\-5 years of experience in Windows systems administration, patch management, or software packaging.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Windows OS internals — registry structure, file system, user vs. system installation scopes, environment variables, and PATH management.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Windows patching tools (WSUS, SCCM/ConfigMgr, Ivanti, Qualys, Chocolatey, or equivalent).
   

  

 Experience with manual patch installation — running MSI/EXE installers, using msiexec.exe with switches, repackaging software.
   

  

 Solid understanding of installer technologies: MSI/WiX, NSIS, InnoSetup, Squirrel, and their silent install mechanisms.
   

  

 Familiarity with the Windows registry and the ability to trace installation artifacts to their registry keys.
   

  

* Nice to Have

description:

 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. * Participate in peer reviews and collaborate with cross\-functional teams across business, product, and technology functions.

* Contribute within Agile delivery teams using standard tools and practices to support quality and timely execution.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You’ll Need To Have**

* 3\+ years of experience in creating use cases, process maps, workflow diagrams, data\-flow diagrams, and functional design documentation.
* 3\+ years of experience in supporting software delivery activities including defect analysis, implementation support, and basic testing.
* 3\+ years of experience in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio.

* Experience contributing to client\-facing solution delivery or implementation activities.
* Experience facilitating design walkthroughs and stakeholder reviews across multiple teams.

description:

 We’re looking for a Head of Growth who wants to be part of building something from the ground up.
   

  

 BDTC is an Training \& Coaching firm established in 2013 and has multiple business unit including an e\-commerce venture too. Our participants pool currently comes from 9\+ countries to India to join our retreats. We are on the verge of scaling aggressively in next 1\-3 years.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who can come in, take ownership of growth, and drive, scale \& build a repeatable and scalable growth engine rather than simply manage marketing campaigns.
   

  

 This is NOT a traditional Digital Marketing role.

 CAC, LTV \& payback
   

 Conversion rate optimization
   

 Organic growth \& content distribution
   

 Growth analytics \& attribution
   

 Building and managing the growth team
   

 Identifying and testing new scalable acquisition channels
   

 Working closely with the founders to build the next phase of the company

 We’re not looking for someone who has simply managed ad accounts or marketing campaigns.
   

 We want someone who has personally taken a business from one level of revenue to another and can show us the numbers.
   

  

 Ideally, you’ve worked with an EdTech, D2C, SaaS, coaching, or high\-ticket education business and have experience scaling it from approximately ₹30–50L/month to ₹2Cr\+/month.
   

  

 You should be:
   

  

 Highly analytical.
   

 Extremely execution\-oriented.
   

 Obsessed with numbers.
   

 Comfortable taking ownership.
   

 Willing to experiment, fail fast and figure things out.
   

  

 The most important question we’ll ask you:
   

 “What have you personally scaled, and what were the numbers before and after?”
   

  

 We care much more about what you’ve actually built and scaled than how impressive your designation sounds.
   

  

 🔥 Why this role is different

 That means you won’t be joining a company where everything is already figured out.
   

  

 You’ll have the opportunity to:

 Set up systems and processes
   

 Build the growth team
   

 Experiment with new acquisition channels
   

 Work directly with the founders
   

 Influence major business decisions
   

 Build the growth engine that can take us to the next level
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership, high\-accountability role.
   

 If you’re looking for a comfortable role where you simply execute an existing playbook, this probably isn’t for you.
   

  

 If you want to build the playbook yourself, this could be a very exciting opportunity.
   

  

 🏢 Work Model
   

  

 6 days a week — Work From Office
   

 This is a fully on\-site role.
   

 No hybrid / remote option is available.
   

  

 We’re intentionally looking for someone who wants to work closely with the founders and the core team, especially during this critical stage of the company’s growth.
   

 💰 Compensation
   

  

 ₹12L–25L\+ CTC, depending on experience and track record.
   

  

 📈 Significant performance\-linked upside
   

  

 You’ll work directly with the founders and have significant autonomy to build and lead the growth function.
   

  

 If you’ve actually built and scaled a serious growth engine, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Content Planning & Execution
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an
 **AVP – Brand (Content Focused)** 
 to own the planning, production and execution of content across key consumer touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, delivery\-oriented role for someone who knows how to take a content plan from brief to final output, coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders, and ensure a consistent volume of high\-quality content is shipped on time.
   

  

 The role will work closely with the growth team and leadership to translate the brand direction into content across social media, app, WhatsApp, packaging and other consumer\-facing channels. A significant part of the role will also involve managing shoots, creators, freelancers and external production partners.
   

  

 This is
 **not a traditional Creative Director role** 
 . While strong creative judgement is important, success in this position will be defined primarily by the ability to run a disciplined content engine and deliver consistently.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Content Planning \& Execution
   

  

* Own and manage the monthly content calendar across social media, app, WhatsApp, packaging and other relevant brand channels.
* Translate the content plan into clear briefs, timelines and deliverables for internal and external teams.
* Coordinate assets from briefing through production, review and final delivery.
* Ensure content is delivered consistently and within agreed timelines.
* Maintain visibility on work in progress, dependencies and upcoming content requirements.


 Content Production \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Manage a network of freelance editors, photographers, designers, production partners and shoot crews.
* Write clear creative and production briefs and ensure external partners understand the expected output.
* Review creative work and provide actionable feedback on quality, brand fit and execution.
* Manage production costs and work towards maintaining an efficient cost per asset without compromising output quality.
* Build a reliable production workflow capable of supporting a consistent volume of content.


 Shoots \& On\-Ground Production
   

  

* Own product, farm and factory\-related shoots end\-to\-end, including planning, coordination and execution.
* Work with photographers, videographers, production teams and relevant internal stakeholders to ensure shoots are completed as planned.
* Be comfortable being present on location and managing the practical requirements of content production.
* Ensure shoot outputs are translated efficiently into usable content across multiple formats and channels.


 Creator \& Influencer Operations
   

  

* Run the creator and influencer programme as a structured operating process.
* Source and evaluate relevant creators and influencers.
* Manage negotiations, briefs, timelines, deliverables and follow\-ups.
* Track output quality and ensure creator content is aligned with the broader brand direction.


 Growth Creative Support
   

  

* Work closely with the growth team to ensure a consistent weekly pipeline of creative assets.
* Understand creative performance data and use it to inform what types of content and formats should be produced next.
* Help increase the volume of relevant creative while maintaining brand and execution standards.


 Brand Consistency
   

  

* Maintain consistency in the brand's voice, visual identity and core consumer narrative across all content.
* Ensure the brand's farm\-to\-home trust story is represented consistently across touchpoints.
* Translate the leadership team's positioning and brand direction into day\-to\-day content execution.
* Review outgoing content for quality, consistency and adherence to the agreed brand direction.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

* 4\-7 years of experience in a brand, creative or D2C growth agency environment.
* Experience in account management, client servicing, brand solutions or a similar role involving ownership of content delivery.
* Demonstrated experience managing content calendars across multiple brands, campaigns or workstreams.
* Strong track record of coordinating production teams, freelancers and external creative partners against deadlines.
* Experience managing content from briefing through production, review and final delivery.
* Comfortable working directly with photographers, editors, designers, creators and shoot teams.
* Strong creative judgement with the ability to assess whether content meets the expected quality and brand standard.
* Highly execution\-oriented, organised and comfortable managing several content deliverables simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with performance data and using creative learnings to influence subsequent content production.
* Willing to take a hands\-on role in shoots and on\-ground content production.
* Pune\-based or willing to relocate to Pune.


**Preferred Experience**
* Exposure to food, dairy, wellness, FMCG or adjacent consumer categories.
* Experience working with D2C or digitally led consumer brands.
* Hands\-on ability to produce or edit content independently would be a strong advantage.
* Experience managing creator or influencer programmes as an ongoing operating process.


 What Success in This Role Looks Like
   

  

 Success in this role will come from building a dependable content operation: calendars are planned ahead, briefs are clear, production partners deliver on time, shoots run smoothly, creators are managed systematically, the growth team receives the creative volume it needs, and everything that reaches the consumer remains consistent with the brand's voice and positioning.

description:

**Work Hour 5:30 PM to 1:30 PM**
 As a Collections Junior Specialist at Infobip, you will be in the Order to Cash part of the team, which handles monitoring and billing, sending invoices, reconciling usage reports, analyzing revenue and prepaid balances, and communicating with clients regarding payment concerns while collaborating with various internal teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strictly Following internal dunning and collection procedures to ensure payment on, or before the due date as per customer agreements
* Continuous communication with the clients through over calls and emails to understand their concerns in terms of bill disputes, bill break\-up summary \& any other specific requirements of the customers for processing the payments
* Actively maintaining customer base of minimum 300 C/B Segment Customer
* In\-Depth knowledge of collection procedure and implementation within her/his customer portfolio
* Actively managing doubtful debt and write\-offs, and LPC Calculations
* Management of Customer Collections Master Data In Salesforce
* Monitor/Review customer account details for non\-payments, delayed payments, and other irregularities
* Research payment discrepancies
* Preparing and reviewing AR aging
* Accurate tagging of customers and invoicing collections tool
* Internal Stakeholder Management
* Internal/External escalations
* Dispute Management


**More About You**
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in collections, AR and/or billing
* Experience working on aged accounts in a B2B environment
* Advanced English is required for this role.
* Experience in communicating with clients via email, phone and online meetings.
* Bachelors degree on Accounting or Finances (plus)
* Great communication skills with internal and external stakeholders
* Knowledge in collections and Billing management.
* Knowledge of MS Office tools \- especially Excel
* Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Enthusiasm for learning and adapting to new challenges.


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.

* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.

* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.**

title: Workplace Specialist
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive
 **Workplace Specialist** 
 to join our Workplace team. The Workplace Specialist will lead the planning, execution, and monitoring of technical operations related to workplace infrastructure, ensuring optimal functionality, compliance, and safety. This includes oversight of HVAC, electrical systems, fire safety, preventive maintenance, and Emergency Response Team (ERT) management. The role is a full time in office and would be reporting directly to the Director, Workplace Asia, Middle East \& Africa
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* Emergency Facility Repairs \& Breakdown Handling
* Lead coordination during critical infrastructure breakdowns and service disruptions.
* Mobilize internal and external resources to resolve facility emergencies promptly.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain a facility incident log for review, audits, and trend analysis.
* Preventive Maintenance (PPM) Management
* Plan, execute, and track preventive maintenance schedules for all workplace systems.
* Ensure all PPM records are updated, validated, and compliant with audit standards.
* Monitor vendor SLAs and maintenance quality metrics to ensure service excellence.
* Promote data\-driven maintenance practices to optimize asset performance and longevity.
* Workplace Infrastructure Assessments
* Conduct routine assessments of all workplace infrastructure including HVAC systems, electrical panels, fire safety equipment, and structural facilities.
* Evaluate the physical condition and performance of workplace assets to detect wear\-and\-tear, potential failures, or inefficiencies.
* Collaborate with vendor partners and internal stakeholders to ensure timely inspections, servicing, and reporting.
* Oversee the maintenance and operational condition of workplace furniture, including workstations, chairs, and ergonomic equipment, to prevent breakdowns or safety hazards.
